Friends, We are **46 days** from Election Day, and a lot is on the line. This race is a toss-up, which means flipping NY-17 is within reach, but it is not guaranteed. Over the next 46 days, we need all hands on deck knocking doors, making calls, and reaching voters in every corner of the district. Let’s leave everything on the field and win this together. Because our district and our country deserve better. Team Cait

Derek, We’re about to ask you to [**make your first donation of 2026 to the DNC**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2026-gfr?refcode=em_20260918_9234_fr&refcode2=9234_22930333_h3e_ot&akid=9234%2E22930333%2Eh3e_ot) — but first, we hope you’ll give us a chance to explain why we’re coming to you with this urgency, because you deserve the truth: Here’s what’s happening:

* His administration publicly talks about the possibility of ICE agents in polling places.

clean_body: Peter, I'm going to make a prediction... When the votes are counted this November, the radical left is going to be in a state of total shock. And the political establishment is going to spend weeks trying to explain what hit them. But that only happens if Republicans like you are on record before the Midterms. That is how consequential this moment is. But here is the part the pundits won't tell you. None of that happens automatically. The Democrats are at war with the American people -- open borders, defunding ICE, eliminating voter ID, putting men in women's sports. You name it, they are on the wrong side of it. And yet they are running the most radical, well-funded Senate candidates in states across this country who are counting on Republicans to stay home and let them walk right in. I will not let that happen. And I don't think you will either. I made you a prediction at the beginning of this email. I stand by every word of it. But that prediction is built on one assumption -- that Republicans like you are engaged and ready to fight. That is where your assessment comes in. Sincerely, Newt Gingrich Former Speaker of the House | Paid for by the NRSC. Not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. |

name: Jeff Bridges
subject: Five Counties. One Saturday.
body:
Summit, Lake, Park, Chaffee, Fremont. And everywhere we went, we heard about some version of the same problem—Colorado has become really expensive.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/8f13298e8974/get-more-smarter-on-colorados-budget-10378791?e=b48bb2b4f4)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/Ww4X_4ZN0dg?e=b48bb2b4f4&c2id=bbe572662fdb5fed2d0855c1bcb00da8)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Hi there,
Last Saturday was a big day on the trail.
I headed into the mountains with Colorado Democratic Party Chair Shad Murib for five stops in five counties: Summit, Lake, Park, Chaffee, and Fremont.
And everywhere we went, we talked about some version of the same problem—Colorado has become really expensive.
Housing. Utility bills. Child care. The basic cost of building a life here.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/14nX0WY7o8i?e=b48bb2b4f4&c2id=bbe572662fdb5fed2d0855c1bcb00da8)
| |
That’s a big part of why I’m running for Treasurer.
The Treasurer manages billions of dollars on behalf of the state. I think we should put more of those Colorado dollars to work here in Colorado.
That means investing in:
* Housing working people can actually afford
* Infrastructure our communities and our economy need
* Renewable energy that lowers utility bills and protects the Colorado we love

Those ideas look a little different in every community.
In the mountains, housing costs make it harder for teachers, nurses, firefighters, and other workers to live anywhere near the people they serve. Growing communities need infrastructure. Families everywhere are trying to figure out how to make the math work at the end of the month.
The Treasurer can’t solve every one of those problems. But when you control billions of dollars in investments, you should ask how every dollar available can help.

Five counties. One Saturday. A lot of miles. And plenty more Colorado still to cover.

Thank you to everyone who welcomed us, asked good questions, and shared what’s happening in your community.
I learn something every time I get out on the road, and I’m looking forward to doing a lot more of it between now and November. I'm actually typing this on I-70 just outside Rifle!
---

subject: How can a $3 million fundraising goal change this race?
body:
We’re entering the final stretch of this campaign and need the financial resources to match our momentum.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)

Peter,
We have an official Texas Ethics Commission fundraising deadline on September 24th, and my team has set an ambitious goal of raising $3 million from online donations by then.
You may be wondering: _How can a $3 million fundraising goal change this race?_ Well, let me explain.
Raising $3 million means entering the final stretch of our campaign with the financial resources to match our incredible grassroots momentum to unseat Greg Abbott.
September 24th marks the end of this critical reporting period — and the totals we report will show the public, the media, and our opponent the true strength of our movement.
**I’m proud of what we’ve built together.** A fight for our public schools, lowering costs, and protection from corporations taking over our resources. And when Greg Abbott sees our momentum, he’ll use the massive $67 million war chest he is sitting on to try to silence us before November.
So raising $3 million from grassroots supporters like you will send a signal across Texas showing that we have the people power to back this campaign to finally elect him out of office.
**[Will you chip in $5 right now to help us reach our $3 million goal before the September 24th TEC deadline?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260918_4_tec._ishL5&refcode=em20260918-2170&amount=5&t=2&akid=2170%2E299639%2E6zuleT)**

Thank you,
Gina

| |
# Caught with her hand in the cookie jar
---
| | | | | | Friend,
Two days ago, [campaign finance reports revealed that **Deb Haaland accepted $87,200 from Oracle America and from executives at Clayco**](https://us.list-manage.com/4215XnRLWPf?e=530e36cac1&c2id=62f28c177cd28b25da81790396be4810)**, the company building Project Jupiter.** Several of those were maximum donations of $12,400 each.
Yesterday, she called a press conference to announce that on day one as governor, she would sign an executive order halting new data center projects across New Mexico.
**Two days.** That is the entire distance between cashing those checks and standing at a podium demanding a ban.
[**She got caught with her hand in the cookie jar**](https://us.list-manage.com/MYoxPW_QWEt?e=530e36cac1&c2id=62f28c177cd28b25da81790396be4810)**,** and that press conference was damage control.
Here is where I stand, and where I have stood since long before anyone was reading finance reports. I have not accepted a dollar from big data. I have not solicited one. And I am not going to shut the door on an entire industry to get through a news cycle, because a blanket moratorium tells every employer looking at New Mexico that we are closed for business at exactly the moment we should be competing.
I do not support a blank check either. Data centers have to be sited responsibly, with real accountability for water use, for energy impact, and for the communities that live next to them. That is the work. It is harder than a press conference, and it is what I did for twelve years as Mayor of Rio Rancho.
My opponent can afford to change her position whenever the coverage turns. I answer to New Mexicans, and that is exactly how I want it.
So I am asking you directly. **A contribution of $25 puts this story in front of voters who have not seen it yet. $50 keeps our ads running in Albuquerque and Las Cruces through the weekend. $100 helps us reach the undecided voters who will decide this race in November.** You can give right now at [GreggHull.com](https://us.list-manage.com/xacIHsyiNq5?e=530e36cac1&c2id=62f28c177cd28b25da81790396be4810).
Every dollar we raise comes from people who want a governor with a record, not a governor with donors to manage.
Thank you for standing with me,
---
|

body:
New FBI Records on Trump Assassination Attempt

[INSIDE JW]

JUDICIAL WATCH UNCOVERS ANTI-CHARLIE KIRK EMAILS AT UTAH UNIVERSITY

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38684&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly95b3V0dS5iZS9zTmdSOUg2clhEWT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=6ea6d6ad7623c422e2f4e0fb93f149b38663ed6f222aaff0e6ef9f9f19903258]

We obtained 133 pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38672&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3V0YWgtdmFsbGV5LXVuaXYtY2hhcmxpZS1raXJrLXJlY29yZHMtcHJvZC0zLTIwMjYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=b6454d551e2b3e3c8ca89fe09cfc4dec0ebe721e33994a3da5122863e9343995]
of records from Utah Valley University (UVU) revealing sharply
anti-Charlie Kirk messages from individuals identified as university
faculty or instructors in the weeks following Kirk’s assassination
on the UVU campus.

Charlie Kirk, founder of Turning Point USA, was killed
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38673&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cud2hpdGVob3VzZS5nb3YvcHJlc2lkZW50aWFsLWFjdGlvbnMvMjAyNS8xMC9uYXRpb25hbC1kYXktb2YtcmVtZW1icmFuY2UtZm9yLWNoYXJsaWUta2lyay8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=5db1bad755bf44d15550cfbdc2e625997ce5c944d1b2931983fc1604314f0061]
on September 10, 2025, while kicking off a speaking tour
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38674&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZm94bmV3cy5jb20vdXMvdHVybmluZy1wb2ludC11c2EtY28tZm91bmRlci1jaGFybGllLWtpcmstc2hvdC1raWNrb2ZmLWRheS1hbWVyaWNhbi1jb21lYmFjay10b3VyP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=d4959de8ce9112f1e5db90c37df0f670417b4b38498b529b447b8b3a470e2642]
at college campuses.

We received the records through a Utah Government Records Access and
Management Act (GRAMA) request for emails and text messages concerning
Kirk involving then-UVU President Astrid S. Tuminez.

The records include a September 22 email
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38675&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3V0YWgtdmFsbGV5LXVuaXYtY2hhcmxpZS1raXJrLXJlY29yZHMtcHJvZC0zLTIwMjYtcGdzLTQyLTQzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=ebe2256952eb7dd210318c110b67e83dee937d043be25fc2489588c0b9d0c609]
apparently written by a UVU instructor to President Tuminez. The
writer referred to “students we are trying to educate” and
attacked Kirk in stark terms:

> Charlie Kirk appealed to the worst of us. He spoke his prejudices
> openly, not to test free speech, but to shape minds. He targeted
> impressionable youth, feeding on their fears and anxieties....

> The hidden message in his rants was clear: hate is natural, and to
> resist it is to deny who you are. Hate masquerading as justice is
> nothing of the sort. True justice seeks fairness, accountability,
> and protection for all, while hate targets, divides, and
> destroys....

> That is why we must resist any effort to memorialize him or turn him
> into an icon.... Charlie Kirk did not stand for civility,
> compassion, or truth. There was nothing civil about him.

***

> To memorialize him would be a grave mistake.

In a November 4, 2025, email
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38676&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3V0YWgtdmFsbGV5LXVuaXYtY2hhcmxpZS1raXJrLXJlY29yZHMtcHJvZC0zLTIwMjYtcGdzLTEyMS0xMjIvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=00b46239af45b0134d979966ee110c4a32f896e3701a8599c69d2f58a75e4dbf]
a self-described “faculty member” at UVU writes:

> I’ve had a hard time dealing with the aftermath of the shooting on
> our campus, and in particular, I cannot understand how people could
> support or mourn someone who was so divisive and spewed such
> vituperation in his “debates.” I regret that he was invited to
> UVU at all, and wish you had rethought the decision to allow him a
> forum on our campus.

***

> Also, there has been talk of a memorial to Charlie Kirk that will be
> placed on the UVU campus. The legislature seems determined to make
> it happen, and they have enormous power in Utah. I ask you to resist
> their desire to desecrate our campus with a memorial to such a
> divisive and hateful public figure. Please do not let it happen. It
> does not align with our brand of inclusiveness and welcoming. Should
> a memorial to him be erected on our campus, I fear you will lose
> many faculty members, including myself.

***

> I would not work at a university that supports Charlie Kirk's ideals
> in any way.

The records reveal that just nine days after Kirk was assassinated, a
person whose name is redacted was already proposing a $1 million
fundraising
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38677&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3V0YWgtdmFsbGV5LXVuaXYtY2hhcmxpZS1raXJrLXJlY29yZHMtcHJvZC0zLTIwMjYtcGdzLTE3LTE4Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=9822441d0e79c3a49010d8ef4b97f723b2e524b75e95a92af4550214a178fcad]
effort called “Our Better Selves for a Better America.”

I would like to raise $1 million for this proposal. I took the liberty
of starting a draft. I'd like a very quick turnaround so I can
fundraise quickly. I have one pledge for $100k. I would like to raise
the other $900k quickly.

UVU subsequently established “Our Better Selves for a Better America
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38678&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cudXZ1LmVkdS9vdXJiZXR0ZXJzZWx2ZXMvXeKAnT91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=02b45ac8edaa272e7a50fbd15a00e97d1fbb9e22dec133177ac19499a10d51a5 as a university-wide
initiative focused on civil dialogue, disagreement, conflict
resolution, and civic responsibility.

The newly released records show that, behind the university’s public
appeals for unity and free expression, some members of the UVU faculty
were expressing a very negative attitude toward Kirk and his
supporters.

Charlie Kirk was assassinated while exercising his right to speak on a
college campus. These records reveal that, even as Utah Valley
University publicly called for free expression and civil discourse,
some faculty members were making hateful and vicious comments about
him, objecting to his invitation to campus, and threatening to leave
if his memory were honored.

We previously obtained records
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38206&F=T&&hash=30d634dff06108ef4255ed1116346fd96781e56710beb57c554b2d9f4a0a6fa9]
from Utah Valley University through this same records request
detailing the university’s efforts to immediately pave over the site
where Kirk was murdered.

FBI RECORDS REVEAL THOMAS CROOKS BEHAVIOR BEFORE TRUMP SHOOTING

Thomas Matthew Crooks, who attempted to assassinate Donald Trump at a
July 2024 campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, purchased “a chest
rig and ceramic plates,” and exhibited increasingly unusual
behavior, including talking to himself, pacing at night, staying awake
for extended periods and exhibiting impulsivity issues.

We learned this from 180 pages
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38665&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTgtMDIyMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=6e802ceaab9afcc2cf7808c9e0e82d34cfcc2874b74a9bc4e117edec5274e8df]
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38655&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTgtMDIyMTYvXW9mP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=00cc0e281c20dee2d9c82e89b2f15f929d331bc2ce474c77982d6332fde9ac05
heavily redacted Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) records we
received through a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit.

We filed our July 2025 FOIA lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=35667&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcmVjb3Jkcy1vbi10cnVtcHMtYXNzYXNzaW4vP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=5a2539e4190081aa5bc9396065d03c4375cbc83dc966f8556af7061e14293249]
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38009&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcmVjb3Jkcy1vbi10cnVtcHMtYXNzYXNzaW4vXWFmdGVyP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=a25363e132f2b36c7a91dcac17c2191e057c096cb2937dd241e7e504517fe004 the
FBI failed to respond to a July 2024 request for records concerning
Crooks and the assassination attempt (_Judicial Watch Inc. v. U.S.
Department of Justice_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=35650&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLXRob21hcy1jcm9va3MtY29tcGxhaW50LTAyMjE2Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=66b51d91588c6d63e35bbd303052e5da4229729edc7ee3eedc1799f0dab64517]
(No. 1:25-cv-02216)).

In a July 15, 2024, FD-302 FBI interview report
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38656&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTgtMDIyMTYtcGdzLTM5LTQyLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=5bf0a13bd83af0827abe21d046988206de5a07ad438bf68f546b70363c882ca6],
an individual whose name is redacted wrote:

> Thomas purchased ammo online, going from website to website until he
> found a site that would sell to him. Thomas recently bought a chest
> rig and ceramic plates. Thomas had recently gotten into rapid action
> range transition shooting where shooters would enter a timed range
> and switch between weapons while moving.

***

> As Thomas became older, he started to get more agitated when
> [Redacted] and [Redacted] asked questions. Thomas talked to himself
> a lot. After community college he would talk to himself more and
> more, moving his hands and speaking to himself. This activity kept
> [Redacted] awake at night as sometimes. Thomas would stay up all
> night dancing in [redacted]. Thomas seemed to have endless energy.

***

> Thomas was never diagnosed with any mental health disorders as a
> child, but did have impulsivity issues.

A July 15, 2024, FBI i
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38685&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTgtMDIyMTYtcGdzLTYtNy9dbnRlcnZpZXc/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=53a45925964567bf6caeefe48f43970bf92e1d1820c66328001e2e7e3a111971
report
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38657&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTgtMDIyMTYtcGdzLTYtNy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=85ca7f99ec6afb3bd557b5f721952ef499d9166db256973432eb1f291312156d]
states that Crooks purchased firearms courses from Keystone Shooting
Center online, including a basic carbine course beginning May 25,
2024, a basic handgun course beginning June 13, 2024, and an
intermediate handgun course beginning June 22, 2024. The courses were
purchased using the email address tmcrooks7@gmail.com.

A July 25, 2024, FBI report
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38658&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtZG9qLWNyb29rcy1wcm9kLTgtMDIyMTYtcGctMTIzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycyZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1DTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0Q=&hash=41d2b0fdee9da0a3fdd803ef3a06fae92628714e8b7ec402e7f2b8098cb7695c]
states that Crooks was seen with two older men at a firearms store.
Employees of Keystone Armory in Edinboro, PA, contacted the FBI about
Crooks’ May 2024 visit:

> The individual believed to be Crooks was accompanied by a white male
> believed to be around his mid 30s and another older white male with
> a gray beard, potentially ... the individual’s father. The
> individual believed to be Crooks and the two other males can be seen
> wandering throughout the firearms store looking at various firearms.
> The individual believed to be Crooks subsequently purchased 20
> rounds of Red Army 7.62x54R 148 gr FMJ and left shortly thereafter.

> The store provided the FBI with a receipt of ammunition purchase, a
> list of the store’s witnesses of the “person of interest” and

with the pseudonyms
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38642&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly90aGVuZXdhbWVyaWNhbi5jb20vdXMvb2tjL3VuZGVyY292ZXItdGhlLWhvd2UtcmV2ZWxhdGlvbnMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJzJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRA==&hash=63064fabfa98a131de78f4497ada5bf60ad81ab4bb627c245e1d46f3c1cf4923]

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=85498&L=38643&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93ZWIuYXJjaGl2ZS5vcmcvd2ViLzIwMjUwNDI0MTE1MjQzL2h0dHBzOi9qb25yb25zb24uc3Vic3RhY2suY29tL3AvdGhlLWRlYXRoLW9mLWNhcm9sLWhvd2U/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE&hash=a115feacbb5bf65b750d5e81268880429ee2388157bac19d844ac5fc4b44918e]

clean_body: New FBI Records on Trump Assassination Attempt [INSIDE JW] JUDICIAL WATCH UNCOVERS ANTI-CHARLIE KIRK EMAILS AT UTAH UNIVERSITY [] We obtained 133 pages [] of records from Utah Valley University (UVU) revealing sharply anti-Charlie Kirk messages from individuals identified as university faculty or instructors in the weeks following Kirk’s assassination on the UVU campus. Charlie Kirk, founder of Turning Point USA, was killed [] on September 10, 2025, while kicking off a speaking tour [] at college campuses. We received the records through a Utah Government Records Access and Management Act (GRAMA) request for emails and text messages concerning Kirk involving then-UVU President Astrid S. Tuminez. The records include a September 22 email [] apparently written by a UVU instructor to President Tuminez. The writer referred to “students we are trying to educate” and attacked Kirk in stark terms: Charlie Kirk appealed to the worst of us. He spoke his prejudices openly, not to test free speech, but to shape minds. He targeted impressionable youth, feeding on their fears and anxieties.... The hidden message in his rants was clear: hate is natural, and to resist it is to deny who you are. Hate masquerading as justice is nothing of the sort. True justice seeks fairness, accountability, and protection for all, while hate targets, divides, and destroys.... That is why we must resist any effort to memorialize him or turn him into an icon.... Charlie Kirk did not stand for civility, compassion, or truth. There was nothing civil about him. * To memorialize him would be a grave mistake. In a November 4, 2025, email [] a self-described “faculty member” at UVU writes: I’ve had a hard time dealing with the aftermath of the shooting on our campus, and in particular, I cannot understand how people could support or mourn someone who was so divisive and spewed such vituperation in his “debates.” I regret that he was invited to UVU at all, and wish you had rethought the decision to allow him a forum on our campus. Also, there has been talk of a memorial to Charlie Kirk that will be placed on the UVU campus. The legislature seems determined to make it happen, and they have enormous power in Utah. I ask you to resist their desire to desecrate our campus with a memorial to such a divisive and hateful public figure. Please do not let it happen. It does not align with our brand of inclusiveness and welcoming. Should a memorial to him be erected on our campus, I fear you will lose many faculty members, including myself. I would not work at a university that supports Charlie Kirk's ideals in any way. The records reveal that just nine days after Kirk was assassinated, a person whose name is redacted was already proposing a $1 million fundraising [] effort called “Our Better Selves for a Better America.” I would like to raise $1 million for this proposal. I took the liberty of starting a draft. I'd like a very quick turnaround so I can fundraise quickly. I have one pledge for $100k. I would like to raise the other $900k quickly. UVU subsequently established “Our Better Selves for a Better America [ as a university-wide initiative focused on civil dialogue, disagreement, conflict resolution, and civic responsibility. The newly released records show that, behind the university’s public appeals for unity and free expression, some members of the UVU faculty were expressing a very negative attitude toward Kirk and his supporters. Charlie Kirk was assassinated while exercising his right to speak on a college campus. These records reveal that, even as Utah Valley University publicly called for free expression and civil discourse, some faculty members were making hateful and vicious comments about him, objecting to his invitation to campus, and threatening to leave if his memory were honored. We previously obtained records [] from Utah Valley University through this same records request detailing the university’s efforts to immediately pave over the site where Kirk was murdered. FBI RECORDS REVEAL THOMAS CROOKS BEHAVIOR BEFORE TRUMP SHOOTING Thomas Matthew Crooks, who attempted to assassinate Donald Trump at a July 2024 campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, purchased “a chest rig and ceramic plates,” and exhibited increasingly unusual behavior, including talking to himself, pacing at night, staying awake for extended periods and exhibiting impulsivity issues. We learned this from 180 pages [] [ heavily redacted Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) records we received through a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit. Thomas would stay up all night dancing in [redacted]. Thomas seemed to have endless energy. * Thomas was never diagnosed with any mental health disorders as a child, but did have impulsivity issues. A July 15, 2024, FBI i [ report [] states that Crooks purchased firearms courses from Keystone Shooting Center online, including a basic carbine course beginning May 25, 2024, a basic handgun course beginning June 13, 2024, and an intermediate handgun course beginning June 22, 2024. The courses were purchased using the email address tmcrooks7@gmail.com. A July 25, 2024, FBI report [] states that Crooks was seen with two older men at a firearms store. The communication states: “Review of the web browser history of the device revealed the device accessed mailfence.com [] multiple times from 15 April 2024 to 8 July 2024.” In a July 15, 2024, electronic communication [], the FBI Counterterrorism unit requested assistance from a foreign government concerning information on the Samsung S136 device belonging to Crooks. A July 21, 2024, FBI report [] quotes a former Community College of Allegheny County laboratory classmate who said he “tried to get to know Crooks, told him jokes and invited him to go out.” According to the classmate, Crooks was “very self-isolated and kept to himself.” Crooks seemed to be very smart, and he clearly had the best grades in the class as he was teaching others. Around two weeks later, ICE removed Kharwin from its Alternatives to Detention (ATD) program and DHS allowed him to apply for asylum and work authorization and fly domestically. The Afghan national remained free in the United States for about a year until biometric and biographical information positively identified him on the terrorist watchlist and ICE Fugitive Operations arrested him in San Antonio, Texas. On November 8th, 2022, after a difficult, expensive, and hard-fought reelection campaign, I called my opponent to offer my concession and congratulations.

It wasn't a pleasant call to make. But I've never second-guessed the decisions that led me there.

If we haven't met: I entered the Naval Academy at 17 and spent 20 years in the Navy as a nuclear engineer, my entire career aboard combatant ships.

In 2018, I ran for Congress and flipped Virginia's 2nd District.

I'm also a mom, which is still the best job I've ever had.

In Congress, I served on the January 6th Committee, knowing full well it could cost me my seat. That cycle, outside far-right groups spent $6,059,677 against me. Add a national environment that was brutal for frontline Democrats, and I came up short.

**For me, the worst outcome isn’t losing a fight. It’s going down with no fight at all.**

So I'm back, running to win this seat back from Jen Kiggans, because I can't sit on the sidelines and watch our country descend into chaos.

The Cook Political Report rates VA-02 a Toss-Up. This is one of Democrats’ best pickup opportunities in the country.

Republicans know it too. Jen Kiggans called Elon Musk's DOGE cuts "so necessary," even as they hit Hampton Roads hard. Musk's super PAC has started spending to keep her in office and beat me. Trump just spent $1.5M on ads against me in this district.

That's why September 30th matters. It's my last end-of-quarter FEC deadline before Election Day, and the report that follows is public. HEADLINES: Battle for the Midterms | Record Breaking Progressives | Greg
Casar on Building Our Ranks | Jackson & Nixon on the Senate | Nina Turner:
Happy Birthday Our Rev! | & MORE!

★ ★ ★

THE BATTLE FOR THE MIDTERMS IS ON!

We are at an inflection point in American history — and the future hinges
on these Midterms.

On Monday, thousands of Our Revolution activists joined us for our 2026
Battle for the Midterms Kickoff, as we fired up our grassroots operation
for the final stretch to Election Day.

The opportunity in front of us is enormous: flip the House and Senate,
elect a record number of progressives, and fundamentally change the
balance of power in Washington.

After a decade of building progressive power from the ground up, Our
Revolution Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese is rallying our movement
to put our organizing into action:

“We’ve spent 10 years building the infrastructure, developing the leaders,
and proving that grassroots organizing can overcome Big Money and the
establishment. Now, we have an opportunity to put all of that experience
to work in one of the most consequential elections of our lifetime.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39761?t=1011&akid=11332%2E5885482%2EZ9YBVl ]WATCH THE MIDTERMS BATTLE KICKOFF HERE

★ ★ ★

FLIP CONGRESS — WITH 22 NEW HOUSE PROGRESSIVES!

Remember what a game changer it was to elect the Squad and grow it? Well
now we could send a massive wave of 22 NEW progressives to the House.

Rep. Greg Casar, Chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, joined us
to talk about what it would mean to dramatically grow our ranks in the
House — and use that power to deliver for working people.

“We have to flip the House, flip the Senate, but flip it with people who
actually want to fight the corporate interests that have been screwing us
over for far too long and make sure we have a Democratic Party that is
pro-worker and anti-billionaire.”

He laid out the dynamics of key House races like firefighter Sam Forstag
in the red state of Montana, union teacher Randy Villegas in a red
district in California, and other working class fighters ready to take
seats in November.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39762?t=1012&akid=11332%2E5885482%2EZ9YBVl ]Chip in any amount ASAP to power Our Revolution’s proven voter turnout
machine in these exciting House races coast to coast!

★ ★ ★

THE BATTLE FOR THE SENATE

This November we could add SIX bold new champions to join Bernie Sanders
in the U.S. Senate! [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39762?t=1013&akid=11332%2E5885482%2EZ9YBVl ]Chip in to elect the Super Senate Six!
On Monday, we heard from two of these great candidates ready to shake up
Washington: Angie Nixon in Florida and Troy Jackson in Maine.

Angie won the primary after being outspent by the establishment Democrat
16 to 1! Now she’s mobilizing the grassroots to take on the Florida
Republican machine.

“Before I became a state rep, before I became a lawmaker, before I became
the Democratic nominee for United States Senate, I was an organizer.”

And she summed up the strategy behind her campaign in one powerful line:
“Organized people will beat big money each and every day of the week. We
just got to get the people organized.”

In Maine, Troy Jackson told us he’s seeing an extraordinary level of
grassroots energy as his campaign heads into the final stretch against GOP
Senator Susan Collins.

“Since 30 years ago, I’ve been waiting for the day that everyday
working-class people can rise up... Right now, people are showing up like
crazy.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39762?t=1014&akid=11332%2E5885482%2EZ9YBVl ]It’s Big Money versus people power. And we're betting on ALL OF US.
Chip in a donation today to power our 5 million voter contact operation
over the next SIX WEEKS!

★ ★ ★

PEOPLE POWER CAN BEAT BIG MONEY

Newly elected Rep. Aisha Wahab knows firsthand what it means to go up
against massive outside spending — and win.

After facing millions of dollars in the special election, Aisha told us
the answer isn't trying to match Big Money dollar for dollar. It's about
connecting directly with voters at the doors, on the phones, and
delivering a clear contrast to the opposition.

“Our Revolution was with us here on the ground. Real people telling
neighbors why they’re voting, what they care about, what they want to see
done — that’s really the biggest part of our campaign and how we were able
to push back.”

Our Revolution activists helped make tens of thousands of calls into
Aisha's district — exactly the kind of grassroots operation we're now
scaling up across the country heading into November. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39763?t=1015&akid=11332%2E5885482%2EZ9YBVl ]Chip in here to
power our Phonebank Force.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39764?t=1016&akid=11332%2E5885482%2EZ9YBVl ]SIGN UP TO MAKE CALLS WITH OUR TEAM

★ ★ ★

BUILDING LOCAL POWER IN A RED STATE

Our Revolution Board Chair Megan Green joined us to show what building
progressive power from the ground up can accomplish — even in a red state.

Megan serves as President of the St. Louis Board of Alders, and together
we’re developing the next generation of leaders.

“We’ve been able to build a progressive majority here in the city of St.
Louis — in the middle of a red state. And now we’re taking that organizing
and building power at the state level.”

That's the progressive pipeline we've spent a decade building: organizers
become candidates, win locally, govern, and build upward and outward.

Campaigns come and go. Our movement marches ahead.

★ ★ ★

10 YEARS IN THE FIGHT — AND JUST GETTING STARTED

Few people have been closer to this movement than Nina Turner — former
president of Our Revolution and Bernie Sanders' 2020 national co-chair.

As we celebrate 10 years since Bernie founded Our Revolution, Nina
reflected on how far we've come — and the sustained organizing that made
it possible.

“Ten years is a big deal. We should celebrate what Our Revolution has been
able to accomplish — but understand that we have so much more work to do.”

That's the lesson of our first decade. Political power isn't built in one
election. It's built by organizing year after year, developing leaders and
creating a movement that doesn't disappear when Election Day is over.

Nina's prescription for the next decade? “Organize, organize, organize.”
Ten years down. And we're just getting started.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/35232?t=1017&akid=11332%2E5885482%2EZ9YBVl ]If you can, invest a monthly donation to keep our movement marching
forward — through the Midterms and Beyond.

★ ★ ★

RIGHT NOW: FINISH THE FIGHT TO BAN DARK MONEY

Winning elections is only one part of building power. For 10 years, Our
Revolution has also been organizing inside the Democratic Party to change
the rules themselves.

Last year, that inside/outside strategy delivered a major victory: after
sustained grassroots pressure, the DNC passed a resolution to ban dark and
corporate money from the 2028 presidential primary process.

Now comes the real test: making sure it actually happens.

Our Revolution Founding Chair and DNC member Larry Cohen joined us to lay
out the urgency of the next two weeks as we push the DNC to put forward
the implementation plan:

“Our primaries should belong to the voters in the Democratic Party —
working-class people, Black, brown and white — not to the billionaires and
not to the corporations.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39765?t=1018&akid=11332%2E5885482%2EZ9YBVl ]ADD YOUR NAME: TELL THE DNC TO GET DARK & CORPORATE MONEY OUT OF THE
2028 PRESIDENTIAL PRIMARY

★ ★ ★

45 DAYS. 5 MILLION VOTER CONTACTS.

Now comes the work.

Our Revolution is activating our national voter turnout machine with a
goal of making 5 million voter contacts in key races before Election Day.

We’re making calls. Sending texts. Knocking doors. And mobilizing
volunteers across the country to help elect progressive champions from the
local level all the way to the U.S. Senate.

This is what 10 years of organizing has built.
Now it's time to use it.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39763?t=1019&akid=11332%2E5885482%2EZ9YBVl ]CHIP IN TO THE MIDTERM BATTLE FUND

It’s all hands on deck — and on the phones. We’re training up new
volunteers right now to expand our Phonebank Team. It’s a lot of fun and
it’s the best way to make the biggest impact on these Midterms. Sign up
today!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39764?t=1020&akid=11332%2E5885482%2EZ9YBVl ]JOIN OUR PHONE BANK FORCE

★ ★ ★

As Trump and his cronies attack our democracy, we’re organizing alongside
the No Kings Movement for Early Vote turnout and Election Protection.
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39766?t=1021&akid=11332%2E5885482%2EZ9YBVl ]DONATE TO POWER OUR NO KINGS WORK HERE

October 17 will be a MASSIVE nationwide day of action: rallies, block
parties, walks to the polls, and helping neighbors get to their voting
stations. [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39767?t=1022&akid=11332%2E5885482%2EZ9YBVl ]SIGN UP TO HOST A NO KINGS EVENT HERE

When we organize, we win.
★ ★ ★

It’s time to Make Trump Cry in the Midterms.

Let’s take power back from Trump and the oligarchs who are entrenching us
in war, rigging our economy, and targeting our communities. Get your
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/39768?t=1023&akid=11332%2E5885482%2EZ9YBVl ]stickers and other merch to help power our organizing. Thanks for all
of your support!

We just got to get the people organized.” In Maine, Troy Jackson told us he’s seeing an extraordinary level of grassroots energy as his campaign heads into the final stretch against GOP Senator Susan Collins. “Since 30 years ago, I’ve been waiting for the day that everyday working-class people can rise up... Right now, people are showing up like crazy.” [ ]It’s Big Money versus people power. And we're betting on ALL OF US. Chip in a donation today to power our 5 million voter contact operation over the next SIX WEEKS! ★ ★ ★ PEOPLE POWER CAN BEAT BIG MONEY Newly elected Rep. Aisha Wahab knows firsthand what it means to go up against massive outside spending — and win. After facing millions of dollars in the special election, Aisha told us the answer isn't trying to match Big Money dollar for dollar. It's about connecting directly with voters at the doors, on the phones, and delivering a clear contrast to the opposition. “Our Revolution was with us here on the ground. Real people telling neighbors why they’re voting, what they care about, what they want to see done — that’s really the biggest part of our campaign and how we were able to push back.” Our Revolution activists helped make tens of thousands of calls into Aisha's district — exactly the kind of grassroots operation we're now scaling up across the country heading into November. [ ]Chip in here to power our Phonebank Force. [ ]SIGN UP TO MAKE CALLS WITH OUR TEAM ★ ★ ★ BUILDING LOCAL POWER IN A RED STATE Our Revolution Board Chair Megan Green joined us to show what building progressive power from the ground up can accomplish — even in a red state. Megan serves as President of the St. Louis Board of Alders, and together we’re developing the next generation of leaders. “We’ve been able to build a progressive majority here in the city of St. Louis — in the middle of a red state. And now we’re taking that organizing and building power at the state level.” That's the progressive pipeline we've spent a decade building: organizers become candidates, win locally, govern, and build upward and outward. Campaigns come and go. Our movement marches ahead. ★ ★ ★ 10 YEARS IN THE FIGHT — AND JUST GETTING STARTED Few people have been closer to this movement than Nina Turner — former president of Our Revolution and Bernie Sanders' 2020 national co-chair. As we celebrate 10 years since Bernie founded Our Revolution, Nina reflected on how far we've come — and the sustained organizing that made it possible. “Ten years is a big deal. We should celebrate what Our Revolution has been able to accomplish — but understand that we have so much more work to do.” That's the lesson of our first decade. Political power isn't built in one election. It's built by organizing year after year, developing leaders and creating a movement that doesn't disappear when Election Day is over. Nina's prescription for the next decade? “Organize, organize, organize.” Ten years down. And we're just getting started. [ ]If you can, invest a monthly donation to keep our movement marching forward — through the Midterms and Beyond. ★ ★ ★ RIGHT NOW: FINISH THE FIGHT TO BAN DARK MONEY Winning elections is only one part of building power. For 10 years, Our Revolution has also been organizing inside the Democratic Party to change the rules themselves. Last year, that inside/outside strategy delivered a major victory: after sustained grassroots pressure, the DNC passed a resolution to ban dark and corporate money from the 2028 presidential primary process. Now comes the real test: making sure it actually happens. Our Revolution Founding Chair and DNC member Larry Cohen joined us to lay out the urgency of the next two weeks as we push the DNC to put forward the implementation plan: “Our primaries should belong to the voters in the Democratic Party — working-class people, Black, brown and white — not to the billionaires and not to the corporations.” [ ]ADD YOUR NAME: TELL THE DNC TO GET DARK & CORPORATE MONEY OUT OF THE 2028 PRESIDENTIAL PRIMARY ★ ★ ★ 45 DAYS. 5 MILLION VOTER CONTACTS. Knocking doors. And mobilizing volunteers across the country to help elect progressive champions from the local level all the way to the U.S. Senate. This is what 10 years of organizing has built. Now it's time to use it. [ ]CHIP IN TO THE MIDTERM BATTLE FUND It’s all hands on deck — and on the phones. We’re training up new volunteers right now to expand our Phonebank Team. It’s a lot of fun and it’s the best way to make the biggest impact on these Midterms. Sign up today! subject: 9 years because of THIS?
body:
---

---

---
_**A Special Message from our Sponsor**_ _Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of_ _Free Speech Daily_ _and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily_ _._
---
| Law Enforecement Legal Defense Fund You’ve heard about Erik on the news. He’s the NYPD Sergeant who threw a cooler at a fleeing drug dealer. | | | | | Dear Friend, I know you and I have never met. But I’m writing to you today because I’m desperate. [**I need your help to stop New York Attorney General Letitia James before she tears my family apart and locks my police officer husband up for the next NINE YEARS for doing his job.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDR9AAwAAAAAAws2Af2JewADTVirkY90TkGoK20mb6is8Ew_jc8l3S_DgDxKAT_yeT4qlJz7kw8IBTRbEZPJCfO9c1PXgfGowCsVEsumG3ylT-QL-J2YtA)
---
| | | This is Erik, me, and our three children in the family photo. I wish I didn’t have to blur our faces. But with the death threats we’ve been getting, I couldn’t afford to take any chances. I should explain... You’ve heard about Erik on the news. He’s the NYPD Sergeant who threw a cooler at a fleeing drug dealer who was speeding a motorcycle down a crowded sidewalk.
---
| | [](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDR9AAwAAAAAAws2Af2K64waQ7qzC4FDKQftFT6_RSf_7plcrMSXk7JW6OUUhwLDD_fzE2rJICRtDOErTmhslqESrnPzj_oxJGCIXQNK1X__llMh3jjXzw)
---
| | | That day, my husband was working a drug operation at a park in the Bronx -- what they call a “buy-and-bust.” After an undercover officer “bought” cocaine from a drug dealer -- a known gang member with a mile-long rap sheet -- Erik’s fellow officers moved in. The drug dealer fled, jumping on a motorcycle and taking off down a crowded sidewalk at top speed, without a helmet. When my husband spotted the drug dealer, he was barreling straight toward where two officers were arresting another suspect. Erik knew if he didn’t act quickly, someone was going to be seriously injured -- maybe even killed. So my husband made a split-second decision. He grabbed the closest thing he could find -- a small cooler --and threw it at the motorcycle to stop the drug dealer before it was too late. Erik’s quick thinking that day saved lives -- the lives of his two fellow officers and the innocent bystanders who could have been hit. But sadly, the drug dealer crashed his motorcycle and died from his injuries. When he got home that night, Erik told me he felt terrible that someone died. But I knew he did what he needed to do to keep his fellow officers safe. And I thought it was obvious to anyone with half a brain knew that this drug dealer’s death, while tragic, was no one’s fault but his own. He was the one who joined a violent street gang... He was the one who sold deadly drugs in a park where kids play... He was the one who drove a motorcycle down a crowded sidewalk at top speed with no helmet on, putting himself and others in danger... But none of that mattered to the NY attorney general. **You see, Letitia James is bankrolled by George Soros. And she’s filled her office with prosecutors who hate cops as much as she does.** And five months after that fateful day... ...she charged Erik with Manslaughter. She didn’t just charge Erik. She and the other anti-cop activists here in New York turned the case into a media circus. They spent the next two years dragging his name through the mud and calling him a racist even though he is a proud Latino with immigrant parents. What did they expect my husband to do -- stand aside and let a drug dealer plow into the other cops with a motorcycle? Things only got worse at the trial. But not only did the judge find Erik guilty... ...he sentenced him to NINE YEARS in prison. The judge even told Erik he made the sentence especially tough as a “general deterrent” to other police officers! This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where the lawyers and judges in our justice system care more about “deterring” cops from doing their jobs than they do about “deterring” criminals from hurting innocent people. It makes you wonder why anyone would want to be a police officer in this day and age. But becoming a police officer in New York City was a childhood dream for Erik. He grew up in the Bronx. His family and friends still live in the area. Erik always told me how proud he was that he got to go to work every day and help get the drugs, guns and crime out of his neighborhood. And when we were getting ready for the trial, we got a flood of letters from people who lived there. Letter after letter talked about how Erik is a man with a heart for the community. But most importantly, he’s a wonderful husband and an incredible dad to our three children. Telling them their father was going to prison was the hardest thing I’ve ever done. Our five-year-old couldn’t understand. Daddy was a police officer. He was one of the good guys. Why would he go to jail? After he was sentenced, Erik was locked up in Riker’s Island in awful conditions. He spent his days in solitary confinement in a dark, filthy cell with blood all over the walls. **This is how Letitia James and Judge Guy Mitchell repaid my husband for 15 years of protecting his neighborhood.** It’s disgusting. It’s unjust. And it’s just plain wrong. Thankfully, Erik’s lawyers told us he has a good chance at an appeal. And after we filed the appeal, the court set Erik free on bond. But as you know, the appeals process is incredibly expensive. I had almost given up hope. But thank the Lord, Erik is a godly man. Through it all, his faith has never wavered -- not once. On his way home from prison, he stopped at our local church to pray and ask God for help. [**And God brought us the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDR9AAwAAAAAAws2Af2L8ZaZ_vPoZFeB417IHws2f97Jziq0J3M8OmEkqYFB0_4fj3sspXLMvvj0IMS_4qQBb4lmLn7VWUX-akha1vymOpFuKWnOdERIfw) You know that LELDF helps innocent law enforcement officers -- and their families -- fight for justice when there’s nowhere else to turn. Thanks to kind-hearted people like you, they get these officers the lawyers and expert witnesses they need to fight back against activist prosecutors and judges... ...and win. < Contact FirstName >, you’ve already read my email this far, so I’m going to come right out and ask: **[Will you be an answer to prayer too? Will you make a $35 gift to LELDF to help fund Erik’s appeal?](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDR9AAwAAAAAAws2Af2MXjC_tE-TkSc0Qjg3JM-RRtwB08XqHNQ19euenHPxHxKkTAKqDwfywGdcgbZVNreiXqgXTDAodMhzcSSLloAZrnPp5MkqvEmxLQ)** I know it’s strange to ask for your support in the very first email I’ve ever written you. But we have nowhere else to turn. Erik and I come from working-class families. We’re not wealthy. And with Erik being found guilty, we lost his salary and our medical benefits. We’re barely getting by as it is. **[So any amount you can donate today to help Erik fight back against Letitia James and clear his name -- whether it’s $35, $50, $100, $500, or even $5,000 -- is such a blessing to our family.](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDR9AAwAAAAAAws2Af2NhvH2po30ph3NPrHXIRxDoNGtDCzBxIUTegCbH3OxP191fmXEhOxvT8gfu-aR1ksIyU5xw35F_wkHFTna4_s781mgpeeDwj924A)** **And because LELDF is a nonprofit, your gift is tax-deductible too**. But whatever God is prompting you to give, please act quickly. Erik’s legal team needs to be working around the clock on this appeal. Because if we don’t fight this injustice, Erik will be imprisoned. And you know how police officers are treated in prison. And when you access the secure donation page, you’ll see there is a box where you can type a message—**[can I ask you to write a brief note of support to Erik?](https://click.parlermailer.com/?qs=ABB7InYiOjEsImQiOjUwMDR9AAwAAAAAAws2Af2OZKNpYDlJbqaAXSl_UYszGWR-fK1ZKI2787by7uyUlWYlojgwjsfr8sR6mA3usoao8cX-_h8e6Z1SBfbasZLEHBz3H45IecdrfQ)** If you’re a believer like Erik, maybe you could write a short prayer. I know it will mean the world to him. Friend, for the past three years Erik told me something over and over again:
---
**“It’s not about the hardships. It’s about the people God sends into your life during difficult times to help you.”**
---
I pray that today you’ll be one of those people God uses to help our family. Thank you, and God bless you. Sincerely,
---
**Cynthia Duran**

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | "View in Browser" A Special Message from our Sponsor Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of Free Speech Daily and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by Free Speech Daily . | Law Enforecement Legal Defense Fund You’ve heard about Erik on the news. He’s the NYPD Sergeant who threw a cooler at a fleeing drug dealer. | | | | | Dear Friend, I know you and I have never met. But I’m writing to you today because I’m desperate. | | | This is Erik, me, and our three children in the family photo. I wish I didn’t have to blur our faces. But with the death threats we’ve been getting, I couldn’t afford to take any chances. I should explain... You’ve heard about Erik on the news. He’s the NYPD Sergeant who threw a cooler at a fleeing drug dealer who was speeding a motorcycle down a crowded sidewalk. | | | | | That day, my husband was working a drug operation at a park in the Bronx -- what they call a “buy-and-bust.” After an undercover officer “bought” cocaine from a drug dealer -- a known gang member with a mile-long rap sheet -- Erik’s fellow officers moved in. The drug dealer fled, jumping on a motorcycle and taking off down a crowded sidewalk at top speed, without a helmet. When my husband spotted the drug dealer, he was barreling straight toward where two officers were arresting another suspect. Erik knew if he didn’t act quickly, someone was going to be seriously injured -- maybe even killed. So my husband made a split-second decision. He grabbed the closest thing he could find -- a small cooler --and threw it at the motorcycle to stop the drug dealer before it was too late. Erik’s quick thinking that day saved lives -- the lives of his two fellow officers and the innocent bystanders who could have been hit. But sadly, the drug dealer crashed his motorcycle and died from his injuries. When he got home that night, Erik told me he felt terrible that someone died. But I knew he did what he needed to do to keep his fellow officers safe. And I thought it was obvious to anyone with half a brain knew that this drug dealer’s death, while tragic, was no one’s fault but his own. He was the one who joined a violent street gang... He was the one who sold deadly drugs in a park where kids play... He was the one who drove a motorcycle down a crowded sidewalk at top speed with no helmet on, putting himself and others in danger... But none of that mattered to the NY attorney general. You see, Letitia James is bankrolled by George Soros. And she’s filled her office with prosecutors who hate cops as much as she does. And five months after that fateful day... ...she charged Erik with Manslaughter. She didn’t just charge Erik. She and the other anti-cop activists here in New York turned the case into a media circus. They spent the next two years dragging his name through the mud and calling him a racist even though he is a proud Latino with immigrant parents. What did they expect my husband to do -- stand aside and let a drug dealer plow into the other cops with a motorcycle? Things only got worse at the trial. But not only did the judge find Erik guilty... ...he sentenced him to NINE YEARS in prison. The judge even told Erik he made the sentence especially tough as a “general deterrent” to other police officers! This is the upside-down world we live in now. A world where the lawyers and judges in our justice system care more about “deterring” cops from doing their jobs than they do about “deterring” criminals from hurting innocent people. It makes you wonder why anyone would want to be a police officer in this day and age. But becoming a police officer in New York City was a childhood dream for Erik. He grew up in the Bronx. His family and friends still live in the area. Erik always told me how proud he was that he got to go to work every day and help get the drugs, guns and crime out of his neighborhood. And when we were getting ready for the trial, we got a flood of letters from people who lived there. Letter after letter talked about how Erik is a man with a heart for the community. But most importantly, he’s a wonderful husband and an incredible dad to our three children. Telling them their father was going to prison was the hardest thing I’ve ever done. Our five-year-old couldn’t understand. Daddy was a police officer. He was one of the good guys. Why would he go to jail? After he was sentenced, Erik was locked up in Riker’s Island in awful conditions. He spent his days in solitary confinement in a dark, filthy cell with blood all over the walls. This is how Letitia James and Judge Guy Mitchell repaid my husband for 15 years of protecting his neighborhood. It’s disgusting. It’s unjust. And it’s just plain wrong. Thankfully, Erik’s lawyers told us he has a good chance at an appeal. And after we filed the appeal, the court set Erik free on bond. But as you know, the appeals process is incredibly expensive. I had almost given up hope. But thank the Lord, Erik is a godly man. Through it all, his faith has never wavered -- not once. On his way home from prison, he stopped at our local church to pray and ask God for help. You know that LELDF helps innocent law enforcement officers -- and their families -- fight for justice when there’s nowhere else to turn. Thanks to kind-hearted people like you, they get these officers the lawyers and expert witnesses they need to fight back against activist prosecutors and judges... ...and win. < Contact FirstName >, you’ve already read my email this far, so I’m going to come right out and ask: I know it’s strange to ask for your support in the very first email I’ve ever written you. But we have nowhere else to turn. Erik and I come from working-class families. We’re not wealthy. And with Erik being found guilty, we lost his salary and our medical benefits. We’re barely getting by as it is. And because LELDF is a nonprofit, your gift is tax-deductible too. But whatever God is prompting you to give, please act quickly. Erik’s legal team needs to be working around the clock on this appeal. Because if we don’t fight this injustice, Erik will be imprisoned. And you know how police officers are treated in prison. And when you access the secure donation page, you’ll see there is a box where you can type a message— If you’re a believer like Erik, maybe you could write a short prayer. I know it will mean the world to him. Friend, for the past three years Erik told me something over and over again: “It’s not about the hardships. It’s about the people God sends into your life during difficult times to help you.” I pray that today you’ll be one of those people God uses to help our family. Thank you, and God bless you. Sincerely, Cynthia Duran P.S. My husband doesn’t deserve this. He’s a decorated police officer who spent his entire career serving and protecting his city. That day in the park, he saved lives. And for that, Letitia James wants him locked up for NINE YEARS. Please don’t let the cop-haters destroy another good man. | | | | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. Hi, Peter – it’s Ken Burns.
Today, I’m asking you to make a donation to Roy Cooper’s campaign for U.S. Senate in North Carolina. Winning this race is absolutely critical if we’re going to flip the Senate, so I hope you’ll join me in supporting Roy. [**_Will you chip in $5?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1316&amount=5&t=9&akid=3466%2E124072%2EJQPZ9x)
Across this country, people are hurting in ways that don’t always make the history books but shape lives all the same.
The grocery bills that are too high. A lifesaving prescription that forces a difficult choice. A paycheck that just doesn’t stretch as far as it once did. | These are the real pressures that define a moment.
**Roy Cooper has spent much of his life as a public servant working to ease those burdens.**
Not seeking attention but doing the work. Expanding access to affordable health care. Investing in public schools. Defending the idea that government, at its best, is not distant but present, steady and accountable to the people it serves.
It is the kind of leadership that rarely makes noise, but over time, it leaves a mark.
Right now, there are those who want to take North Carolina – and our country – in a different direction. They see division as a strategy; they mistake power for purpose. They are organized. They are well-funded by dark-money and special-interest groups.
**The only way we can defeat them is if dedicated, caring people like you choose not to sit back but to take part. The power rests in our hands, and we must use it.**

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

## U.S. Wins Greenland Security Deal
President Trump on Friday announced a [sweeping security agreement](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL2O3CAURp8Gd4wA22AKijTuNm1K6y5cbDb8jPD1rObto5kiL7D1J31H5_z52D4g5VT331DQUWxbxe8zIxH27Tph74g1Qw0BIYf2tV-1X3lTQmkuLJd2A0_pgdsEQ3ARUeE4oJNmsYtUoxHD4SLM0ngAP83aTjqC9EZG7RHUOH_KOCT3-hNWWimEFstNBD8b-znOeokmGMkmgSFR67evliodGPOzPbDffCtDdgfR_WTjL6ZWplY68Eg5vzam1qMVfCkxtUIoqaaTOlBqlalVC2uFmfh_SR6wFuh_-XXyE_3VEz35u0HBSpz6Ve5MrUN34f6dck6nNmwSe4H05g30w4QPp_4FAAD__-bliHM) with Denmark and Greenland granting the U.S. permanent military basing and overflight rights in Greenland. The deal bars China, Russia, and other non-NATO countries from establishing military bases or making [sensitive investments](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LESnCAQBuCn0Q4H8E6goEhjd2lTOhysujcIDqyae_uMKfICqXfnn__7f72ml8OIafnpNrA05ynBVSMQQZmO6pYCkKJLIYCLIX-WI5UjTpLLgXHDhJmcJzxherg22BlAQt-CFUobLWSveLtaIwXXbtYKDKi31LzXTr-NnqXyIOTQor3zuBFGcD5w3fHgn8q8--egZxWUaB4cAlIu3SdjohXm-M0nlM7nrY12Jdpr0_9o5NjI8bqubs6_b8d9b-S454iEvjZypHJsOwvgoytQ2YmecvmyFSvlgp7dTPYPzSr44_7boWwuQSJ2VLZhRHLlywouK9W22LBfGCPWQTUPvmwO499m9J-Dnlb-CQAA__8aKo9y) in Greenland without express U.S. approval. Trump called it an "Infinite Life" agreement with no expiration date. The arrangement falls short of the full acquisition Trump had pushed for since his first term, but it significantly expands the U.S. footprint beyond the existing [1951 defense agreement](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDtuhDAURVdjOpA__Fy4SEM3aVOiB34GT2wzMg_Q7D4iRTaQ-krn6pyvx_gAH3xaPiGiIbeNCa89IBHm8dhhyYgpQLIWIdjtuRwpH2GUXLYl16XQI8zkTxxrKKxxiBJVgUZ0ve6FVB0vVgN2mlUjBLSqbno1tcqBmKxGpxRoxwtvbh7XQgvOW95X3M5NpyfVtL3rbCdYzdF62nL13HyiFV14byfmat5iEcxK9NqZ-mByYHK4rqua0zTfI5PDjWZy4JrJQfRMDpSP-Cr_xEqLKUL-LqMPniC_y1u1WimGIhv7unwIfm87VvMlgg-_n_TPVKeRPwEAAP__LlB9zQ) that established Pituffik Space Base. Trump said the U.S. will immediately begin developing a large military presence on the island.
## DOJ: Young Adults Can Buy Handguns
The Justice Department on Friday [declared unconstitutional](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDtuxCAUAE-DOyyMP0BBkcbdpk1pvYVnmxUGi4-tvX2UKDdIPdJoNF-P5QHOu7B9woG6rHEJeGePpWBaaoYtIQYPwVoEb-NrqyFVv3DGJ8oU7dQCprgLlwEaq1dEjn2DuhNSyY73gjW7lpJJBiOTqJjkqsdRPKUY-skOZoURGqd_fEx1qmNsYrJl1oxCPftxkquwoiMDQ-tKTO0rulB2XP07XphaE4_G672UM5P-g_CZ8Pm-7_ZVc3EG2y1ehM_xBMLnMxE-_wFq8YRUDgyFmhiMrxYzXdFiAk-fEOgOwW410AweM-0k5Yy-ERKN3mZag4khF1dqcTGApxBsk7Q9b-e9y5MgA9sOcP63sPxz7KX5dwAAAP__MxOQOg) the federal ban on licensed dealers selling handguns to adults ages 18 to 20, saying it cannot be criminally enforced under the Second Amendment. The Office of Legal Counsel opinion said [federal criminal penalties may not be imposed](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHupCAQgPGn0U4zgIIUFNfY7bVXmlkYlc0IG8Q19_aXvVf411_yK74_j-WBkWPafuNBrq55SXSfTLVSWa4Tt0KUGFMIhBzya7tSuXiRIHUHthN2QV_jh5YB2-BWIkmqJSfMZCchlYF2dxoFaRzNMJiRSFkxKNLTOPpBKR8I2ui-HlhhBYCGqYfgR2OfatTTaoIRzQAUYs2lf-WY6k4r_80fKr3PR8tur_V9NupXI-dGzvd995j52xo5Y6nRM52NnEN-dYE8Y6GzWylQQe6emLodU9iu1AktRqkAoN_rwW1x4X1H5nhq0wywHRj_q2394aiPk_8CAAD__xIsfNQ) on dealers who sell handguns to law-abiding young adults, though more than a dozen states have their own age restrictions that they can still enforce. The DOJ concluded that 18-to-20-year-olds are among those protected by the Second Amendment and found [no Founding-era tradition](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OgzAUhE9jOke2IRgXLrahy7ZbIsN7gJF5jvyTKLdfsVfYekaj-b6fx_RwPnjavt2JtqxxInzngKVgmmp2W0Kk4AgAXYB4bJVSDZMSqufCcGkmtxT_wqlzDdgVUWHboJV6MINUrRbNbhepZS9lO2jTus51Gme1oumNnttZAzTeXnvCSCOF6MVwE7DctZnbez-sGrRknUDwJabbET2VHdfwiS9MtyWeTbB7Kc_M2i-mRqbGo-ZSdrw4rpypcbu6dCIVpsYl1lQyD-7N1Ajx4PHpyUfiqyfIXA78gy7xGCDzxRGf64fvjmCrlJtk4fn2Ifjca9aJ7XQ-_J0o_3T3suo3AAD__-4dhgU) of barring legal adults from purchasing firearms, noting that militia laws at the Founding required service beginning at age 18.

Warren Buffett, the 96-year-old investor who took control of Berkshire Hathaway in 1965 and transformed it into a [trillion-dollar conglomerate](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L1uhSAYxvGrwU2DLyoyMHRxO107Gj5elFMEA3hM7745vYXOT_J7kv_XY30oH3zcPtWBsrq0RrxLwFoxr1dRW0aMQUVrUQWbntsV8xVWoDC1VLS9WJWp_oXroBorHSIga1D2fBZzD4zTZpecaseYETgiTHyCwYGmyLTGeVIjM42Xb4-KXvSUTnTuqDUjF5qN0-y45T0ZKFpfU-6eyce6ows_6YW5M-logtxrPQthHwQWAst9352J2rxHAsubJrBQQWDpZwKLvpzDWttS8Tx93Fqb7tiq0mrM32X3GVuzK58PFbu9HqHJ0p63D8GXiZOBbofy4e-5_jPYS8JvAAAA__8KRn_y), is stepping down as chairman effective immediately. [1]Justice Democrats

Peter, this
Rolling Stone headline got it right:

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260919.7-a38G&refcode=em20260919-38275&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=38275%2E1203867%2EF0H_7q ]Taxes at work: Trump is reportedly sending Israel $2.8 billion in
bombs. You’re paying for them. It’s described as a sale, but the U.S. is
giving Israel taxpayer money to buy over 40,000 bombs, The Washington Post
reports.

Once again, Donald Trump is sending more bombs and weapons to Israel, to
the tune of $2.8 BILLION. Paid for by U.S. taxpayers.

While this transaction is called a weapons “sale,” the reality is that our
tax dollars are being used to buy 2,000-pound bombs for Israel to drop on
Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, and whoever else they feel like it.

This is the largest single sale of this type of bomb in recent years,
because this controversial weapon “sends metal fragments in every
direction for thousands of feet, can rip through metal and thick concrete,
and often creates large craters in the earth,” per The Washington Post.

Trump and corporate-backed lawmakers on both sides of the aisle claim we
can’t afford universal healthcare or higher wages, but we can foot the
bill to give Israel 40,000 bombs that destroy everything in their path?!

The American people are sick and tired of their hard-earned tax dollars
being used to pay for genocide and forever wars rather than the services
and programs we need to survive and thrive. A 2024 poll found that 52
percent of voters — regardless of political party — believe we should stop
sending weapons to Israel.

This is why we need to keep fighting to defeat politicians in the pocket
of AIPAC and the rest of the Israel lobby, and elect pro-peace
progressives in their place.

## Feds Restore $12B to Texas Hospitals
The federal government will restore nearly $12 billion in [Medicaid funding](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2uqzAQBOCnMZ2RbQjGhYvb0OW2p0RrvMBK5kf2JiRvf5S8wuk_zYzm5z7egRLty3_Y0PNrPsYdr5KQGfMYaGF8FYY9lse5vmOGmTI-ztEo00nlpHYjTExPHFuoog8qOl2h17Z3vb5ZZarV9zB3LQTQfdMbd7NNrw0oaxzoroEJK_KfOOW001rpVtcwt6Gxjepus-usDaJVGImPXPOKjC8oc3ofT8z1dGxV8ivzWUTzT5hBmOG6rvqLOFN47FgfeRFm-HQIMygnzKCtMMPXyA0jTUBRrkc5iSEVuWRcJIRwMMsZI2ZIkrYTSkFhhir7eF6UEpXOilYtG1D6DuG_Hvj05jcAAP__tViGIQ) to Texas hospitals, Gov. Greg Abbott announced on Thursday, ending a year-long dispute with the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services. CMS halted the payments on Sept. 1, the first stoppage since the program began in 2014, over how Texas raises more than $4.2 billion in taxes to access the funds. Hospitals stood to lose [$27 million a day](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL-upCAUh58GOw2gghQU29jdbbc0KAc9CYqB4-i8_WbmFW7_-5Pv-_cz_TiMeKx_3Q6WnpCmA-4SgQjyNONK8BRyhy_Xub19dgEzXOckuVQ1N7Uwk1sIXzB1rvJ25t6ICqzQgxlEr7msNqs8d25QoJ3m_cy7sHBoJTe9hEEoGCq0nzluhBGCi040LnRzq1uu-mCU1jPrOHiklBvagOBxJcR3ekFulrRX0W5EZ2HtHyZHJsf7vpuQHqm2dBVKxyfE5PjhYnL81usdPC4Ofb2lciK5WIfr8HisdYZCKYOvsvXnjTFiUZp1fN0dxu8f_dbTy8r_AQAA__-DoH_a). Advocates warned rural hospitals would be [particularly hard hit](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSpCAURb8GM7oAHZWAYBOz2XRD69E89G0hWPDa6fn7LecXNr916tzz53P9BEqUt99woON3LGvGr5aQGevqaWN8N4Yc2uvcv0OFSBVf52qUGaWyUtsVnkwXrgN0wXkVrO7Q6Wm2s_6YlOl214fBh3keUYfRKu_Bo54tjM8Jte1D6MjdOGW11VrpQT8gDr6fejV-RDtOkxeDwkBc6oN3ZHxDi-m7XFgfz3J0ye3MZxP9L2EWYZb7gPxbXjVDugfCLDdfmEVZYRY9C7NAZKzyKJn3JkuUGbfCBEwlNxkxNAnnWcuFEtJRGkttvKQsDwz0BAoyvnKgvEku8kdImKWrLpxflBK1cRKD2g6gH4GO_7fs5cy_AAAA__8iJ4_H) if the freeze continued. The funds help close the gap between Medicaid reimbursements and the actual cost of treating low-income patients. It's unclear when payments will resume.
## Police Warn AI Is Supercharging Scams
Garland police are warning that scammers armed with [AI-generated voices](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDuOwyAURVeDO1t8HGMKimncZdoprQc820j4I3gJye5HmS1MfaWrc87Pfb5DTPFYv2FHS6_lnA-sJSER5tnFlfBVCI5QHtf2DhmWmPFxzZLLoeWmFWYGT_GJcw9NsI4HIxq0Qo9mFDfNZbNZYeSIxis3KPAuaKeQm1H2g7kNLnDTRPu540YYIbjoRQdL75RWfLgtZtDasZ5jiHTmjjYkfEFZ0vt8Yu78uTfJbkRXYeqLyYnJqdbaHc6HpX5mJqePEZNTOj0kJieIbfGwl7ac1xYLRQ-EoV0hJzhCe50pemwr5IPJqed6NEoxOTXZhqvGlGIZNOv5ukNMfwD033BPK38DAAD__x5Ag3E), images, and emails are impersonating trusted companies and pressuring victims to act fast. Even the department isn't immune: one officer says fake iCloud and Coinbase pitches have landed in his own inbox. The good news: the defense is low-tech. A cloned voice needs only a [short audio clip](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL3OnDAQRZ8GOiP_ALYLF2noNm1KNJgBLNmA7IFd3j7aVOm_5ha3ODo6f17jC0IM-_obEjr6LMe447tEJMI8TmEl_BSCfS7XuT1zhiVkvM5RctkzbpmwI3gKN44t1LOb-GxFjU5oY43oNJf15owBNK02gO1kOFole6FVbzrZ6UkpWwf3xXErrBBctKKBpZ2UVrzvFttrPVUtxznQkRvakPADZYnPcWNu_JHq6Dais1TqVyWHSg7-2MuVMDcL-WY97v8uBhEzlUoOkktVyYF_p3hICXNhV0EGgeG-we6R0YYhswVSiA_DhHnF3T-s-A0Tljq7-XyHGEPpddXyNUGI_4TopyFvJ_8GAAD__wQPiZM) pulled from online posts, so hang up and call back on a number you know. "_The best thing is to not only verify but slow down,"_ Officer Matthew Pesta said. Urgency, secrecy, and demands for specific payment methods are the tells. Americans reported nearly [$21 billion in losses](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O6yAURleDu1iAfzAFRfQkS6_IFNNMiS7mYiMR24IbO9n9aCZLmO7TV5wjna-bvUFMcZ0_4I6GnmGzK54lIRFm6-JM-CwEqy-PfXn5DCFmfOxWctlfuL4IbWGieKBtofLGca9FhUaoQQ-iU1xWiwnagetC75zqNEcIA3d6CoNotW5aAVU0PziuhRaCi1bUEFrXqIb3XdC9Uo61HH2kLde0IOETSkiv7cBcT9u9SmYh2gtrrkyOTI7nedZxaup5O5gcr-v6gPSJ-5aJyfE9CpOj5LKz__8176fefaiy8fsZU4qlV6zl8x1i-lXQX9McRn4HAAD__8M_eXc) to internet crime last year, a 26% jump, and the FBI says crypto-linked complaints drove more than half of it, with AI-linked losses topping $893 million.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/a5bf9133b10c/stand-up-against-the-shameful-gop-power-grab-7363884?e=dc5f639d62)

Hey friends,I'm thrilled to share with you episode 11 of the Standing Tall podcast! I can’t wait for you to hear the stories Rev. Dr. Harold Middlebrook tells in this one.[**[CLICK HERE to LISTEN NOW**]](https://us.list-manage.com/1CkOZwcYPwt?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
****

[**Listen or watch**](https://us.list-manage.com/fKiuhu4EAvp?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)**now wherever you get your podcasts. 🎧**

I was honored to be able to sit down with Rev. Dr. Harold Middlebrook, a Memphis-born civil rights leader who worked directly with Dr. Martin Luther King Jr., organized voter registration drives across the South in the 1960s, and was present at the Lorraine Motel the day Dr. King was assassinated.

The Rev. Harold Middlebrook stands directly behind the Rev. Martin Luther King Jr. during the Memphis sanitation workers' strike in March 1968. Also pictured are the Rev. Jesse Jackson, upper right, and Dr. H. Ralph Jackson, left.

His life spans from a 10th-grade voter registration drive in Memphis to decades of ministry here in Knoxville, and in this conversation he draws some striking, sobering lines between what he fought for then and what we're facing again now.We get into the poll tax and how voter suppression actually worked, why local elections like school boards matter just as much as national ones, and his very direct case for why waiting until Election Day is a risk nobody needs to take.This one is a genuine piece of living history, and I hope it gives you as much perspective as it gave me.

**🗳️Yesterday was National Voter Registration Day!** If you're not registered, or you've moved and need to update your info, today's the day. It takes five minutes and it matters. **Head to**[**proudvoter.org**](https://us.list-manage.com/eyy6XpFHNIB?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)**to check your status or get registered.** Rev. Middlebrook said it best in this episode: getting registered doesn't mean anything if you don't follow through and vote. _**So let's start with step one, today.**_

Thank you for being here,Gloria

body:
[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/18138?t=1001&akid=1894%2E181023%2EVSPS_e ]David Crowley

Now that
I'm Wisconsin's Democratic nominee for Governor, I wanted to take a minute
to introduce myself properly.

I grew up in Milwaukee's 53206 ZIP code, where my family faced food
insecurity and the threat of eviction.

I know what it feels like when the system isn't built for people like me.

That's what got me into public service in the first place.

I got my start in the Wisconsin Legislature, finding common ground with
people I didn't always agree with to pass laws that actually helped
people.

Then I became Milwaukee County Executive, the youngest person and the
first Black person to hold that office, where I brought together labor,
business, and community organizations to build close to 1,000 units of
affordable housing and push for universal childcare for working families.

I'm ready to take this same work ethic to the governor's office to make
lives better for all Wisconsinites.

Wisconsin is one of the closest states in the country. Every one of our
last three presidential elections was decided by less than a point.

And my opponent? He's a far-right election denier who spent his time in
Congress supporting Donald Trump and MAGA extremism.

That's the kind of race we're in, and we need a large coalition to defend
this open seat.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/18138?t=1002&akid=1894%2E181023%2EVSPS_e ]I'm ready for this fight, but I can't do it without support from people
like you. Will you join Jocelyn Benson in helping us build the campaign
this race demands by making a donation today?

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/18138?t=1003&akid=1894%2E181023%2EVSPS_e ]Donate →

Thank you,
David Crowley
