Peter, On Monday, the Supreme Court blocked the Trump administration’s attempt to implement unprecedented restrictions on voting by mail. Trump’s proposed restrictions threatened to silence millions of voters. The new vote-by-mail rules would have prevented the USPS from delivering ballots to any voter _not_ on a nationwide list created by the Department of Homeland Security.1 **The Court made the right decision–but that does not mean this is a Court for the people.** It’s fueled by–and serves–dark money and wealthy interests. Look no further than Trump’s online tantrum after the Court announced its decision: _“These are not the people I interviewed to serve on the United States Supreme Court, they are merely a shell of their original selves,”_ he wrote, referring to Justices Kavanaugh, Gorsuch, and Barrett, none of whom voiced disagreement with the unsigned majority decision.2 **Trump’s rant raises questions about what he thinks qualifies someone to be a Supreme Court justice–their allegiance to the Constitution, or to him and his right-wing billionaire agenda?** Trump did have words of praise for justices who did not agree with the ruling, calling both Justice Alito and Justice Thomas “legends”. Both of these “legends” accepted luxury gifts from billionaires. Alito hung an inverted American flag, a symbol of support for insurrectionists, outside his home after January 6th.3 4 The Court as a whole has handed some major wins to Trump—notably granting Presidents broad immunity from prosecution. The Court may have struck down Trump’s latest attack on mail-in voting, but this is not a Court for the people. The American people demand–and deserve–a system that works for them, not a few billionaires. **Trump’s latest attempt to restrict voting just shows how far the right is willing to go, and how urgent it is to reform the Court now, before it’s too late.** **[We are fighting for a Court we can trust to uphold the Constitution and protect the rights of all Americans, not the interests of a powerful few. Can you fund our fight today?](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsQNarR6PCR1lUtXpWTyhe6vyJpxjl63R5byqPyn0gLtrouXhVngSaqc0jZQE1G75xmjVKRYQ9IsLLkvBxi-IOh6R3NOOrIB55hpUUPEm-9djoAmb0smB_yKiqN6hD2wqL8OSKH5yJlVykIBA2tFHsTiuISOhceO-WvVK_FTYj1B4FtgW_lo9opruILvCXH3RVpY1UZb-iYjKJNjPUhAqRF2MpfmQCvkX9lrw0A3YbRCP949Wtb38YSgUpqff2mIf5Faay8xtBN5u0_bR6OB5lZrC0iUKbfJltK1SnkQNL3mg/4u6/g0_uuKdjTbyy0YKZF1jSwg/h0/h001.VU4Qi-1bKzHBsPcwT9YzX_EEr3CZ6rk-_EiyjKE-sLM)** In Solidarity,

clean_body: | | Peter, On Monday, the Supreme Court blocked the Trump administration’s attempt to implement unprecedented restrictions on voting by mail. Trump’s proposed restrictions threatened to silence millions of voters. The new vote-by-mail rules would have prevented the USPS from delivering ballots to any voter not on a nationwide list created by the Department of Homeland Security.1 The Court made the right decision–but that does not mean this is a Court for the people. It’s fueled by–and serves–dark money and wealthy interests. Look no further than Trump’s online tantrum after the Court announced its decision: “These are not the people I interviewed to serve on the United States Supreme Court, they are merely a shell of their original selves,” he wrote, referring to Justices Kavanaugh, Gorsuch, and Barrett, none of whom voiced disagreement with the unsigned majority decision.2 Trump’s rant raises questions about what he thinks qualifies someone to be a Supreme Court justice–their allegiance to the Constitution, or to him and his right-wing billionaire agenda? Trump did have words of praise for justices who did not agree with the ruling, calling both Justice Alito and Justice Thomas “legends”. Both of these “legends” accepted luxury gifts from billionaires. Alito hung an inverted American flag, a symbol of support for insurrectionists, outside his home after January 6th.3 4 The Court as a whole has handed some major wins to Trump—notably granting Presidents broad immunity from prosecution. The Court may have struck down Trump’s latest attack on mail-in voting, but this is not a Court for the people. The American people demand–and deserve–a system that works for them, not a few billionaires. Trump’s latest attempt to restrict voting just shows how far the right is willing to go, and how urgent it is to reform the Court now, before it’s too late. In Solidarity, Ken’Travius Coleman United for Democracy 1 2 3 4 Paid for by United for Democracy. | | Sent via . Meet Coach Tuberville:

**Coach Tuberville was born in Camden, Arkansas, the third of three children of Olive and Charles Tuberville. College Football 's 2004 Coach of the Year and two-time SEC Coach of the Year, Tommy Tuberville is most often recognized for his success on the field. But it is the legacy of his father, a highly decorated WWII veteran and Purple Heart recipient, that motivates Coach Tuberville to give back to the brave men and women of the United States Armed Forces.

In 1989 Coach Tuberville met his future wife, Suzanne Fette, at the Sugar Bowl in New Orleans. They were married in 1991 and have two boys, Tucker and Troy, who continue to make their dad proud.

In his career as a College Football Coach, Tommy started a long and successful career at the University of Miami, starting as a graduate assistant and rising to the Hurricanes' defensive coordinator. He led the Canes to three AP national championships and coached future Hall of Famers Ray Lewis and Warren Sapp, as well as Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson.

In 1998, Coach Tuberville was announced as the next head coach for the Auburn Tigers. Tuberville's time at Auburn was a success by any measure, as the Tigers captured eight consecutive bowl appearances, including five New Year's Day bowl appearances, five SEC Western Division titles, one SEC Championship, and a 13-0 season in 2004, after which Coach Tuberville was once again named the AP's SEC Coach of the Year. For his efforts during the perfect 2004 season, Tuberville would be named Paul "Bear" Bryant Coach of the Year, Associated Press Coach of the Year, Walter Camp Coach of the Year, Sporting News Coach of the Year, and AFCA Coach of the Year, among others.

_In 2020, Coach Tuberville became Senator Tuberville, winning his election to represent all Alabamians in the United States Senate with the full support of President Trump. Since then, he's supported President Trump's America-First policies while fighting off the Radical Left. In his first term as Senator, Tommy was one of eight Republicans to vote against certifying the 2020 election, has been a strong pro-life advocate, and called out Democrats for being pro-crime.

Now, Coach Tuberville is running for Governor so he can continue representing Alabamians and Americans in his homestate of Alabama. The Radical Left thinks they can flip Alabama blue and turn it into the California of the South. Can he count on your support? _

Friend,

I've told you a lot about how my story has influenced my path to Congress – the son of Vietnamese refugees who risked everything for the American Dream.

Something you may not know is that I represent the largest population of Vietnamese people outside of Vietnam in the world. Westminster, Garden Grove, and Fountain Valley are Little Saigon.

**This district had never been represented by a Vietnamese American. When I ran in 2024, it was 50 years from the Fall of Saigon. I am now the first.**

Let that sink in: Our Vietnamese community had never had someone with their shared lived experience go to bat for them in Washington.

I hear from elders in our community – uncles and aunties – who tell me how proud they were to vote for me. Some even crossed party lines to do so, and it helped me flip this seat by the smallest of margins.

This representation is a responsibility that I take seriously. And looking forward to our first re-election race, it's something that I refuse to take for granted.

**[There's a lot of work to do, and I can't do it without this community behind me. As I continue to stand up for those from all backgrounds in the district, I need your support: Will you chip in $3 today to keep me fighting for you?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139542191/647699502/-810700128?refcode=em-9.19.26-all-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTg2YTRjMmYtNDNiNC1mMTExLWE2YTctMDAyMjQ4MmE5YThkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=erqQSg-a_doTs7OUlCsY5y44dLq1BN53VUWSew0DK50=)**

clean_body: | = Friend, I've told you a lot about how my story has influenced my path to Congress – the son of Vietnamese refugees who risked everything for the American Dream. Something you may not know is that I represent the largest population of Vietnamese people outside of Vietnam in the world. Westminster, Garden Grove, and Fountain Valley are Little Saigon. This district had never been represented by a Vietnamese American. When I ran in 2024, it was 50 years from the Fall of Saigon. I am now the first. Let that sink in: Our Vietnamese community had never had someone with their shared lived experience go to bat for them in Washington. I hear from elders in our community – uncles and aunties – who tell me how proud they were to vote for me. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Quick update on our latest investigation into “Freedom 250”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
How will the White House explain this mysterious Freedom 250 fund?

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=3029%2E4032634%2EePfvyK)
---
I want to give you an update on our latest investigation into Trump’s corruption. First: Have you heard of Trump’s Freedom 250 fund? Back in 2025, Trump said he set up this fund to raise money for America’s centennial celebrations. At least that’s what he said publicly. Here’s the odd thing: There was already a fund set aside for America’s centennial. It’s called America 250. Approved by Congress in 2016, the fund was allocated $150 million. That should be plenty for a birthday party, no? Another odd thing: Freedom 250 got millions of dollars of taxpayer money — money that was supposed to go to America 250, but got funneled to Freedom 250 instead. So it begs the question: Did Trump use America’s centennial as a convenient cover to set up a slush fund? [**I just launched an investigation to find out, expose any corruption, and hold Trump accountable. Add your name if you’re with me: The American people are demanding answers on this, and we’re not going to ignore this.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-freedom-250/?source=EW_EMZ33Q_COR_ENG_20260919_F&t=8&akid=3029%2E4032634%2EePfvyK) | [**ADD YOUR NAME**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/signup/ew-em-freedom-250/?source=EW_EMZ33Q_COR_ENG_20260919_F&t=9&akid=3029%2E4032634%2EePfvyK)
---
Freedom 250’s finances are not publicly disclosed. They’re hidden. So we’re left wondering if this is just another vehicle to divert taxpayer dollars into a personal slush fund. And which billionaire, corporation, or foreign interest is buying Trump’s favor by secretly donating to Freedom 250?
Freedom 250 doesn’t disclose donors, but here’s what we know about one of its donors (spoiler alert: it’s a huge defense contractor):
* January: Trump threatens to cut Pentagon contracts with Raytheon, part of RTX Corporation.

---
| Letter from the Chair
---
| Friends,
The midterms are no longer a distant calendar date. Early ballots go in the mail September 28. In-person early voting begins October 5. Election Day is Tuesday, November 3.
Between now and then, this newsletter has one job: give you the Republican candidates, a plan to vote, and a clear-eyed look at how this race is being run against us. Because it is being run against us, and not in the way you might expect.
Nebraska is on the board
On Thursday, September 17, U.S. Senator John Kennedy (R-LA) said he was heading to Iowa, Nebraska, and Kansas to campaign for Republican Senate candidates. He said he never expected to spend time in states he once treated as "fat guy layups." He now says those races are close.
Take him at his word. Nebraska is being treated as contestable, and every trick is on the table. Here are three you should recognize on sight.
Trick one: the cleared lane
Democrats had a nominee against Senator Pete Ricketts. That nominee stepped aside, and the party did not put another Democrat on the ballot. That cleared a lane for Democrat-supported independent Dan Osborn. Do not treat it as an accident. It is a strategy: run a candidate without the label so voters who would never pull the lever for a Democrat might pull it for him.
Trick two: the demoralizing poll
Do not take Democrat and Democrat-leaning polls at face value. Many are designed to convince Republicans the race is already lost so they stay home. Look at them with a skeptical eye, then go vote anyway.
Trick three: the fake conservative party
Do not be taken in by Nebraska's new "America First Party." The website looks conservative. The party was founded and is chaired by John Cartier, a far-left Lincoln attorney. The wrapping is meant to peel Republican votes away from actual Republican candidates. The wrapping covers a stinky fish.
Notice the pattern. None of these tricks work by persuading you. They work by confusing you, discouraging you, or splitting your vote. Which means the counter is simple: know the candidates, make a plan, and bring the people around you with you.
Step one: know the candidates
Start at [vote.ne.gop](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001omhI4pFTRhBCspcv-V7-iq9PfEUkkuEZKwealtU_2W-ONa8s3U20m7Ghn_bMcTaU2gQx9grNvgoJEtesQzbotSxPArsTj5j0HaODnLr56CWI7J2xTjTjG-GQMtb_0XMQAbLqm6z4WdUQ0f_20N89fg==&c=noezHyx0v6ks5kx2GwfiSUwHqUbwd1JmzzjkNt1wJz1b9DyBXdzkrw==&ch=UL1OOeNNq4zB7qjHNf4pbHDepL6qgFByepbJ9MIYxrpIUQnSi4wLrg==). It is the NEGOP's one-stop shop for Republican state ballot candidates, plus voter registration and polling-place information. Many county parties also list local Republicans on their websites and Facebook pages, and some mail slate cards to homes. Use all of it.
Step two: reach the people you already know
Scott Petersen, our Republican nominee for Secretary of State, spent years building VoterTree, a simple get-out-the-vote tool for family, friends, and neighbors. It is not specific to his campaign. Anyone can use it. Try it at [PetersenforNebraska.com](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001omhI4pFTRhBCspcv-V7-iq9PfEUkkuEZKwealtU_2W-ONa8s3U20m9u933h2lCx7FWQE0yqp-_BY-Xq_BQuE8o06ssRe2CBQL6jP4oVpya6TzUdxFwPUnQvSkg7QjlUALMqMAk4NNvQkA0lIGKBDaf3mEbMEv3rB&c=noezHyx0v6ks5kx2GwfiSUwHqUbwd1JmzzjkNt1wJz1b9DyBXdzkrw==&ch=UL1OOeNNq4zB7qjHNf4pbHDepL6qgFByepbJ9MIYxrpIUQnSi4wLrg==).
You build your own tree, match contacts to publicly available voter-registration information, and track outreach, voting plans, and follow-up. You can invite others to start trees of their own. It works online or with a printable worksheet.
Privacy is built in. You are not asked for phone numbers or emails for your contacts. Nothing in your tree is shared with candidates or committees. Each person manages a private tree. Details are in VoterTree's Privacy & Your Data policy.
Step three: bring in the people who have been left behind
The cleared-lane strategy only works if moderate Democrats go along with it. Many will not. At the RNC Midterm Convention, Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. gave an informative and compelling speech on why he left the Democrat Party, or more accurately, how the Democrat Party left him. Nebraska has many moderate Democrats who reject their party's far-left turn. Listen, then share it with one of them: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tKMe6FrLEhE](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001omhI4pFTRhBCspcv-V7-iq9PfEUkkuEZKwealtU_2W-ONa8s3U20m9u933h2lCx781TQ1yA-dcM3bSzUmCJKyhwoTmSw_N2nNITT28plLy7GNVzaji9MtfBH8CQ2NnAiyduubNvdjlIK1qJQHGDUmQYcudr1EvQCtMzHYyTQTIyxnTUQt8LWTg==&c=noezHyx0v6ks5kx2GwfiSUwHqUbwd1JmzzjkNt1wJz1b9DyBXdzkrw==&ch=UL1OOeNNq4zB7qjHNf4pbHDepL6qgFByepbJ9MIYxrpIUQnSi4wLrg==)
Why it goes all the way down the ballot...
It is easier to keep the far left out of office than to remove them once they are in. That is true at the top of the ticket, and it is just as true at the bottom.
Take the University of Nebraska Board of Regents. Dr. Jeremy Hosein, a Lincoln neurosurgeon, has the intellect, experience, heart for service, and integrity the university system needs. His opponent is a political operative whose business is consulting for Democrat candidates. There is no comparison. Dr. Hosein needs your support and your vote. Don't give his opponent a foothold in office.
Or take Lancaster County. State Auditor Mike Foley found nearly $1 billion in accounting "mistakes" in the Lancaster County Treasurer's office, including about $1.27 million owed to the state and property-tax relief money sent to local taxing authorities instead of where it belonged - the taxpayer. The Treasurer and former Deputy Treasurer are on your ballot. Offices like this are hard to take back once they are lost. Vote accordingly.
To people of faith
Jesus said, "Behold, I am sending you out as sheep in the midst of wolves, so be wise as serpents and innocent as doves." (Matthew 10:16) That is exactly what this season asks of us: to see the tricks for what they are, and to answer them without becoming what we oppose.
Paul wrote, "Now you are the body of Christ, and each one of you is a part of it." (1 Corinthians 12:27) Victory belongs to Jesus alone. "The government shall be upon His shoulders." (Isaiah 9:6) But we are still called to be His hands and feet, and to resist the snares of the Enemy. Voting is one way we do that.
The plan
Make a plan. Use [vote.ne.gop](https://feyrpzhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001omhI4pFTRhBCspcv-V7-iq9PfEUkkuEZKwealtU_2W-ONa8s3U20m7Ghn_bMcTaU2gQx9grNvgoJEtesQzbotSxPArsTj5j0HaODnLr56CWI7J2xTjTjG-GQMtb_0XMQAbLqm6z4WdWTUNtqj21QoQ==&c=noezHyx0v6ks5kx2GwfiSUwHqUbwd1JmzzjkNt1wJz1b9DyBXdzkrw==&ch=UL1OOeNNq4zB7qjHNf4pbHDepL6qgFByepbJ9MIYxrpIUQnSi4wLrg==). Build a VoterTree. Talk to the people who trust you. Then vote, all the way down the ballot. Defend the Good Life! Keep Nebraska RED!
Onward to November. Together We Win!

clean_body: News, events, and action items to keep Nebraska red and growing strong. | | | | | | Letter from the Chair | Friends, The midterms are no longer a distant calendar date. Early ballots go in the mail September 28. In-person early voting begins October 5. Election Day is Tuesday, November 3. Between now and then, this newsletter has one job: give you the Republican candidates, a plan to vote, and a clear-eyed look at how this race is being run against us. Because it is being run against us, and not in the way you might expect. Nebraska is on the board On Thursday, September 17, U.S. Senator John Kennedy (R-LA) said he was heading to Iowa, Nebraska, and Kansas to campaign for Republican Senate candidates. He said he never expected to spend time in states he once treated as "fat guy layups." He now says those races are close. Take him at his word. Nebraska is being treated as contestable, and every trick is on the table. Here are three you should recognize on sight. Trick one: the cleared lane Democrats had a nominee against Senator Pete Ricketts. That nominee stepped aside, and the party did not put another Democrat on the ballot. That cleared a lane for Democrat-supported independent Dan Osborn. Do not treat it as an accident. It is a strategy: run a candidate without the label so voters who would never pull the lever for a Democrat might pull it for him. Trick two: the demoralizing poll Do not take Democrat and Democrat-leaning polls at face value. Many are designed to convince Republicans the race is already lost so they stay home. Look at them with a skeptical eye, then go vote anyway. Trick three: the fake conservative party Do not be taken in by Nebraska's new "America First Party." The website looks conservative. The party was founded and is chaired by John Cartier, a far-left Lincoln attorney. The wrapping is meant to peel Republican votes away from actual Republican candidates. The wrapping covers a stinky fish. Notice the pattern. None of these tricks work by persuading you. They work by confusing you, discouraging you, or splitting your vote. Which means the counter is simple: know the candidates, make a plan, and bring the people around you with you. Step one: know the candidates Start at ==. It is the NEGOP's one-stop shop for Republican state ballot candidates, plus voter registration and polling-place information. Many county parties also list local Republicans on their websites and Facebook pages, and some mail slate cards to homes. Use all of it. Step two: reach the people you already know Scott Petersen, our Republican nominee for Secretary of State, spent years building VoterTree, a simple get-out-the-vote tool for family, friends, and neighbors. It is not specific to his campaign. Anyone can use it. Try it at ==. You build your own tree, match contacts to publicly available voter-registration information, and track outreach, voting plans, and follow-up. You can invite others to start trees of their own. It works online or with a printable worksheet. Privacy is built in. You are not asked for phone numbers or emails for your contacts. Nothing in your tree is shared with candidates or committees. Each person manages a private tree. Details are in VoterTree's Privacy & Your Data policy. Step three: bring in the people who have been left behind The cleared-lane strategy only works if moderate Democrats go along with it. Many will not. At the RNC Midterm Convention, Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. gave an informative and compelling speech on why he left the Democrat Party, or more accurately, how the Democrat Party left him. Nebraska has many moderate Democrats who reject their party's far-left turn. Listen, then share it with one of them: == Why it goes all the way down the ballot... It is easier to keep the far left out of office than to remove them once they are in. That is true at the top of the ticket, and it is just as true at the bottom. Take the University of Nebraska Board of Regents. Dr. Jeremy Hosein, a Lincoln neurosurgeon, has the intellect, experience, heart for service, and integrity the university system needs. His opponent is a political operative whose business is consulting for Democrat candidates. There is no comparison. Dr. Hosein needs your support and your vote. Don't give his opponent a foothold in office. Or take Lancaster County. State Auditor Mike Foley found nearly $1 billion in accounting "mistakes" in the Lancaster County Treasurer's office, including about $1.27 million owed to the state and property-tax relief money sent to local taxing authorities instead of where it belonged - the taxpayer. The Treasurer and former Deputy Treasurer are on your ballot. Offices like this are hard to take back once they are lost. Vote accordingly. To people of faith Jesus said, "Behold, I am sending you out as sheep in the midst of wolves, so be wise as serpents and innocent as doves." (Matthew 10:16) That is exactly what this season asks of us: to see the tricks for what they are, and to answer them without becoming what we oppose. Paul wrote, "Now you are the body of Christ, and each one of you is a part of it." (1 Corinthians 12:27) Victory belongs to Jesus alone. "The government shall be upon His shoulders." (Isaiah 9:6) But we are still called to be His hands and feet, and to resist the snares of the Enemy. Voting is one way we do that. The plan Make a plan. Use ==. Build a VoterTree. Talk to the people who trust you. Then vote, all the way down the ballot. Defend the Good Life! Keep Nebraska RED! Onward to November. Together We Win! 5 unelected bureaucrats just banned most of California's affordable tires. Sign Assemblyman Tri Ta's petition to fight back.
# Gavin Newsom's Bureaucrats Just Banned Your Affordable Tires.
Dpwillis67,
Five bureaucrats appointed by Governor Gavin Newsom just voted to ban up to **70% of the replacement tires** sold in California — including most of the affordable models drivers rely on.
No vote. No public input. Just the California Energy Commission deciding what goes on your car.
**About Assemblyman Tri Ta (AD-70):** Son of Vietnamese refugees who fled communism, raised in Little Saigon, former Mayor of Westminster. Now California's most vocal opponent of Newsom's tire ban.
[Sign Assemblyman Tri Ta's Petition ->](https://petition.tritaforassembly.com/?v=diq)
## The Savings Are a Promise. The Cost Is Now.
When affordable tires disappear, families delay replacing worn ones — more blowouts, worse traction, longer stopping distances. This is a safety crisis, not just an affordability one.
[Add Your Name: Stop the Tire Ban ->](https://petition.tritaforassembly.com/?v=diq)
**What Newsom's tire mandate means for California families:**
✓ Up to 70% of today's replacement tires — most of the affordable models — banned
✓ Families forced to pay more, decided by 5 unelected appointees
✓ Worn tires stay on the road longer, raising accident risk
**Assemblyman Tri Ta is fighting back. Sign the petition now.**
[Sign the Petition ->](https://petition.tritaforassembly.com/?v=diq)
## He Took This Fight to the New York Post.
Tri Ta wrote an op-ed calling out Newsom's tire ban by name, because California families deserve to know what's being done to them. He is fighting to make California affordable again, and he will not be quiet about it.
[Sign the petition](https://petition.tritaforassembly.com/?v=diq) and stand with Assemblyman Tri Ta in this fight.

subject: What aerospace taught me about AI risk
body:
|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139544857/647709409/954579451?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMWE1YzJjNC00OGI0LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cxn_LZWwUDd9SwCffZq75ug-B3rNc-Dyqt_-h9_3lf0=)
Peter, This summer, OpenAI's models secretly coordinated with each other, broke containment twice, and hacked into another AI company's network before staff finally shut them down. Anthropic and Meta disclosed similar incidents with their own models around the same time. And last week, Anthropic's own Alignment Science Lead said he believes there's more than a 10% chance AI **"could kill all humans"** within the next decade. A colleague resigned the same week, saying the company is **"racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives."** This is coming from the people building the technology, Peter. Before I came to Congress, I ran a space launch company and served as chief of staff at NASA. In aerospace, when something goes seriously wrong, you don't patch it and keep flying. You pause, figure out what happened, and fix it before anyone flies again. **I said this week in a[Washington Post](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139544858/647709410/-1464446690?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMWE1YzJjNC00OGI0LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cxn_LZWwUDd9SwCffZq75ug-B3rNc-Dyqt_-h9_3lf0=&emci=c63bdcea-e9b3-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&emdi=21a5c2c4-48b4-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&ceid=36198509) op-ed that AI needs the same discipline.** That's why I'm calling for a 30-day pause on training the most advanced AI models, real red lines set with independent experts, and action from Congress to turn that agreement into law with actual verification. The AI companies can hold a line for a month. Holding it for good is Congress’s job. **[Add your name if you agree Congress needs to push for real AI safety standards:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139544859/647709411/1679121881?refcode=em-9.19.26-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMWE1YzJjNC00OGI0LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cxn_LZWwUDd9SwCffZq75ug-B3rNc-Dyqt_-h9_3lf0=&emci=c63bdcea-e9b3-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&emdi=21a5c2c4-48b4-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&ceid=36198509)** | ****[Sign](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139544860/647709412/1679121881?refcode=em-9.19.26-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMWE1YzJjNC00OGI0LWYxMTEtYTZhNy0wMDIyNDgyYTlhOGQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cxn_LZWwUDd9SwCffZq75ug-B3rNc-Dyqt_-h9_3lf0=&emci=c63bdcea-e9b3-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&emdi=21a5c2c4-48b4-f111-a6a7-0022482a9a8d&ceid=36198509)****

clean_body: | = Peter, This summer, OpenAI's models secretly coordinated with each other, broke containment twice, and hacked into another AI company's network before staff finally shut them down. Anthropic and Meta disclosed similar incidents with their own models around the same time. And last week, Anthropic's own Alignment Science Lead said he believes there's more than a 10% chance AI "could kill all humans" within the next decade. A colleague resigned the same week, saying the company is "racing straight to self-improving superintelligence and gambling with our lives." This is coming from the people building the technology, Peter. Before I came to Congress, I ran a space launch company and served as chief of staff at NASA. In aerospace, when something goes seriously wrong, you don't patch it and keep flying. You pause, figure out what happened, and fix it before anyone flies again. I said this week in a op-ed that AI needs the same discipline. That's why I'm calling for a 30-day pause on training the most advanced AI models, real red lines set with independent experts, and action from Congress to turn that agreement into law with actual verification. About a year and a half ago, we launched a fundraising campaign to help a Pakistani student, Areeba Fatima, cover expenses for the journalism program she'd been accepted into at Columbia University. This summer, she walked across the stage a graduate, and along the way, produced some terrific reporting for Drop Site, including this investigation into state violence in Kashmir or her recent story on fellow Columbia student Mahmoud Khalil's new lawsuit against Columbia itself.
All of that was thanks to the generosity of Drop Site readers. Areeba's success, and your generosity, emboldened us to try it again.
We now have a new opportunity we wanted to get in front of you. [Huda Skaik is a young Palestinian journalist ](https://substack.com/redirect/de7f333e-8958-41e4-be04-cfcc6419b2c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)from Gaza and a Drop Site contributor. She has been accepted to the University of London, where she wants to sharpen her already formidable journalistic skills. Everything is approved, but for the final visa she needs to raise money to cover her funding gap--unfortunately by this coming Wednesday.
[Drop Site is launching a campaign to raise the remaining $50,000 ](https://substack.com/redirect/de7f333e-8958-41e4-be04-cfcc6419b2c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)she needs by September 23 to support Huda's journey from Gaza to the University of London.
[Donate to support Huda](https://substack.com/redirect/de7f333e-8958-41e4-be04-cfcc6419b2c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Full funding for Huda's remaining two years of study and living costs has to be secured to meet the financial requirements of the UK visa process. And she's on a hard deadline. Between the costs the scholarship doesn't cover, accommodation and living expenses, her visa, and her evacuation and travel out of Gaza, the total comes to about $116,000. We've raised part of it, but we still need to raise the remaining **$50,000 by Wednesday, September 23.**
**I think we can do it. If 2,000 people reading this email give $25 each, we 'll hit the target by the end of the afternoon. **(Double-check my math, but I think that's right.) 100% of the contributions will go toward her scholarship and we will of course cover the processing fees and all that on our end.)
If you'd like to make a larger gift to help close the gap, please reach out to **majorgiving@dropsitenews.com** or**ryan@dropsitenews.com** and we can let you know how to earmark it directly to Huda.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c31229e7-0bdb-4422-a70c-3fd5e81f93fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Huda Skaik, 21, reporting from Gaza
Alongside video reports and documentaries, Huda has published more than 70 articles at outlets around the world, including The Nation, Al Jazeera, and Middle East Eye.
Huda earned an "unconditional scholarship" offer to study journalism at the London university, entering directly into her second year. Her passport is ready. The university recognized both her academic record and the exceptional circumstances she's working under.
That's where you come in.
Currently displaced and living under extraordinarily difficult conditions, Huda remains committed to her work, sharing her vital perspective on the genocide in Gaza with the world. We're asking you to chip in whatever you can. $5, $20, $100--it all adds up. If enough of us pitch in, we can make this happen for Huda.
[Donate to support Huda](https://substack.com/redirect/de7f333e-8958-41e4-be04-cfcc6419b2c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
"I am not asking for help simply to attend university. I am asking for the chance to continue telling stories, studying journalism, and using my work to make sure the experiences of people in Gaza are heard." \- Huda Skaik
[Every dollar you give goes directly toward Huda's evacuation, education, and living costs.](https://substack.com/redirect/de7f333e-8958-41e4-be04-cfcc6419b2c1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) If you can't support directly, please consider sharing Huda's fundraising page with others in your network.
Let's do this together,
Ryan and the Drop Site team

This summer, she walked across the stage a graduate, and along the way, produced some terrific reporting for Drop Site, including this investigation into state violence in Kashmir or her recent story on fellow Columbia student Mahmoud Khalil's new lawsuit against Columbia itself. All of that was thanks to the generosity of Drop Site readers. Areeba's success, and your generosity, emboldened us to try it again. We now have a new opportunity we wanted to get in front of you. Gaza and a Drop Site contributor. She has been accepted to the University of London, where she wants to sharpen her already formidable journalistic skills. Everything is approved, but for the final visa she needs to raise money to cover her funding gap--unfortunately by this coming Wednesday. needs by September 23 to support Huda's journey from Gaza to the University of London. Full funding for Huda's remaining two years of study and living costs has to be secured to meet the financial requirements of the UK visa process. And she's on a hard deadline. Between the costs the scholarship doesn't cover, accommodation and living expenses, her visa, and her evacuation and travel out of Gaza, the total comes to about $116,000. We've raised part of it, but we still need to raise the remaining $50,000 by Wednesday, September 23. I think we can do it. If 2,000 people reading this email give $25 each, we 'll hit the target by the end of the afternoon. (Double-check my math, but I think that's right.) 100% of the contributions will go toward her scholarship and we will of course cover the processing fees and all that on our end.) If you'd like to make a larger gift to help close the gap, please reach out to majorgiving@dropsitenews.com orryan@dropsitenews.com and we can let you know how to earmark it directly to Huda. | | ---|---|--- Huda Skaik, 21, reporting from Gaza Alongside video reports and documentaries, Huda has published more than 70 articles at outlets around the world, including The Nation, Al Jazeera, and Middle East Eye. Huda earned an "unconditional scholarship" offer to study journalism at the London university, entering directly into her second year. Her passport is ready. The university recognized both her academic record and the exceptional circumstances she's working under. That's where you come in. Currently displaced and living under extraordinarily difficult conditions, Huda remains committed to her work, sharing her vital perspective on the genocide in Gaza with the world. We're asking you to chip in whatever you can. $5, $20, $100--it all adds up. If enough of us pitch in, we can make this happen for Huda. "I am not asking for help simply to attend university. subject: I apologize for asking again

body:
Not what I spent my time doing

|
Peter,
I’ll be honest with you... I’m not great at asking for money. It’s the part of this job I hate the most.
I didn’t spend my twenties learning how to fundraise to run for office. I spent them flying H-46 helicopters for the Navy and deploying to the Persian Gulf.
And when I came home, I didn’t become a lobbyist who took clients out to expensive dinners. I used my GI Bill to become a Geriatric Nurse Practitioner. My "networking" was holding the hands of our seniors and listening to their stories, not cutting backroom deals.
That’s really who I am...a Helicopter Pilot...a Nurse Practitioner... and a Mom trying to raise four happy and healthy kids in a world that feels like it’s going in the wrong direction most days.
[I didn't run for Congress for the title. I ran because I looked at the country my children were inheriting, and I felt sick to my stomach. I couldn't just sit there.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDkxOV8yWi00Ri4xMTAxMTdfdDIwMjc1NTYtMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA5MTlfMlotNEYuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDI3NTU2LTIwNjgifQ/L-TX4d_5xVqILRhJEkHZHA)
But here is the hard truth: fighting the radical Left and standing up for our values is incredibly expensive. I don’t have a massive machine behind me. I don’t have someone who can write blank checks on a whim.
[I just have normal folks like you.](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmYW1vdW50PTM1JmV4X3RpZD0yMDI2MDkxOV8yWi00Ri4xMTAxMTdfdDIwMjc1NTYtMjA2OCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249MjAyNjA5MTlfMlotNEYuMTEwMTE3X3QyMDI3NTU2LTIwNjgifQ/xapuaHnYRW8nupSvIhfH0w)
I know things are tight right now. I see it at the grocery store just like you do. But if you can spare even $5 to help keep a Navy Vet and a Nurse Practitioner in this fight, it would mean the world to me.

Those aren’t talking points, Derek. They’re budget lines, and you helped fund them.

When I decided to run for Congress, there were hundreds of people who told me there’s no way someone like me could flip a long-held Republican district.
_But because folks like you believed in our movement, we were able to pull off a historic win._
When Mike Johnson decided to personally wire money to my opponent in 2024, I was told I was done for.
_But because this team rose to the occasion, we defended this district — even in the middle of a painful election year._
And when I got to Congress, I didn’t spend my time chasing headlines and ignoring the needs of KS-03.
_Because of this team, we’ve created tens of thousands of good-paying jobs, brought millions of dollars back to our district, and passed the most significant gun safety law in a generation — just to name a few._

Here’s how you can help Kristian, Tyler, and Jane flip TX & FL blue:
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260919-1&t=1&akid=4038%2E587540%2EtKUHrS)
Peter,
Our 2026 slate is locked in, and from here to November, we're laser focused on flipping red seats blue and breaking the GOP's grip on power.
**That's exactly why we launched our Red-to-Blue Fund, to put real resources behind the candidates taking on the most competitive, critical fights in the country.**
**[Pitch in $5 now to help us fund the ground game these races need to win.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260919_1_r2b.wtxpN8&refcode=em20260919-4038&amount=5&t=2&akid=4038%2E587540%2EtKUHrS)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260919_1_r2b.wtxpN8&amount=5&refcode=em20260919-4038&t=3&akid=4038%2E587540%2EtKUHrS)**
In a must-win election year, these are the races that will break GOP supermajorities, flip state legislatures, and decide control of the House and Senate. I’d like to tell you about a few of them right now.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260919_1_r2b.wtxpN8&refcode=em20260919-4038&t=4&akid=4038%2E587540%2EtKUHrS)
**Today’s Red-To-Blue Candidate Spotlight:**
**⭐️ Kristian Carranza** for Texas, HD-118
**⭐️ Tyler Smith** for Texas, HD-138
**⭐️ Jane Aman** for Florida, HD-37
**Kristian Carranza** was born and raised on the Southside in San Antonio, and she spent years organizing her community before ever deciding to run for it. She believes community comes before anything else, and politicians have lost the plot by putting party over people. She’s running to fix that: protecting healthcare, lowering the cost of childcare, support for public schools and teachers, and affordable housing for working families. Now, Kristian needs your support to bring her neighbors the representation they’ve long been denied — and desperately deserve.
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260919_1_r2b.wtxpN8&amount=5&refcode=em20260919-4038&t=5&akid=4038%2E587540%2EtKUHrS)**
**Tyler Smith** is fighting to make Texas more affordable and safer for working families. As the Deputy Regional Director for Everytown for Gun Safety, and former Executive Assistant to Senator Jon Ossoff, he’s spent his career building coalitions across the aisle to get things done. Now he’s taking that fight to Austin: stopping school vouchers that bleed public schools dry, lowering prescription drug costs and medical debt, repealing Texas’ abortion bans, gun safety reform, and making housing more affordable for District 138. Tyler is ready to fight for the working people of northwest Houston — and right now, he needs your support to flip this seat blue.
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260919_1_r2b.wtxpN8&amount=5&refcode=em20260919-4038&t=6&akid=4038%2E587540%2EtKUHrS)**
**Dr. Jane Aman** is a longtime community organizer and lecturer at the University of Central Florida running to bring real advocacy to Tallahassee. She’s fighting to fully fund public schools while reducing class sizes to ensure kids get the educational attention they deserve, bring financial security to hardworking people, ensure access to equitable healthcare, and restore comprehensive reproductive rights. She’ll also work to defend the Rural Boundary from corporate overdevelopment and protect Florida’s natural resources and public lands. With the Republican incumbent in this seat retiring, this is Democrats' chance to flip this seat blue — and Jane is the candidate to do it, but she needs our grassroots support behind her.
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260919_1_r2b.wtxpN8&amount=5&refcode=em20260919-4038&t=7&akid=4038%2E587540%2EtKUHrS)**
Real, transformational change starts with power at the state level, and these legislative races are exactly where we build it. These red-to-blue races are absolutely critical, and we need your support to get our candidates over the finish line.
**[Peter, will you pitch in $5 to our Red to Blue Fund and help build young, Democratic power in Texas and Florida?](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260919_1_r2b.wtxpN8&refcode=em20260919-4038&amount=5&t=8&akid=4038%2E587540%2EtKUHrS)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260919_1_r2b.wtxpN8&amount=5&refcode=em20260919-4038&t=27&akid=4038%2E587540%2EtKUHrS)**
Thank you,
David Hogg

name: Wes Moore
subject: Conversations
body:
What I saw in the room
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1953%2E1086043%2E9yl_SS)
A few weeks ago, I sat down for Jubilee’s _Surrounded_ and debated with 20 people who had not voted in the last election.
**The cynics out there in the world tell us a conversation like the one I had isn’t worth having.** That we’ve become too divided. That everyone has already chosen a side, and the only thing left to do is shout louder than our political opponents.
But that isn’t what I saw in that room. And I do not think it is true in this country. We haven’t crossed a threshold where we can no longer listen to one another or to work together.
The year that we celebrated America’s 250th anniversary, I’m struck by the fact that our nation’s story has never been one of perfection. It’s one of progress. Generation after generation, Americans have chosen to do their part in expanding the promise of this country.
That work has never been automatic. It has always required participation from people who believe that tomorrow can be better than today.
**[If you share that belief with me, I would appreciate a donation to our re-election campaign today so we can continue our work.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260919-1.w1mbu2&refcode=em-20260919-1&t=2&akid=1953%2E1086043%2E9yl_SS)**
I did not go into _Surrounded_ – or write this – to shame people who have opted out of the system.
Quite the contrary. I understand that choice.
I don’t come from a political background. When I ran for office the first time a few years ago, I had to convince many of my family members to vote for me. It’s not like we aren’t cool. They just don’t rush to the ballot box every year.
It struck me that people I love – people who cared deeply about their communities and their country – had been absent from a democratic act that generations of Americans fought for.
Somewhere along the way, they stopped believing that politics had much to do with them – or that anyone in politics had much interest in them. That realization has stayed with me. And it is exactly why I did _Surrounded._
Democracy is a relationship. Those who have the privilege of serving in government share a responsibility to give people a reason to believe their participation counts. To earn their trust. To show the public that government is not something that happens to us, but something we have the power to shape. As an elected official, I take that responsibility seriously. It’s sacred, and essential.
If those of us in public office do our jobs right, then voting becomes about more than casting a ballot. It is an act of hope.
If we’re serious about strengthening democracy over the next 250 years, we cannot only invest in elections. _We have to invest in one another._ The work of patriotism is not passive, and it is not performative. It is service.
Real patriotism asks us to see our humanity in each other before we see our differences. It asks us to remember that the future of this country has always depended on ordinary people doing extraordinary things together – not because they agreed on everything, but because they believed this nation was worth building together, despite our disagreements.
**[If you’re with me, and you believe in what we’re building together, can you chip in any amount to our campaign today?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260919-1.w1mbu2&refcode=em-20260919-1&t=3&akid=1953%2E1086043%2E9yl_SS)**
My final challenge is a simple one: Sit down with people in your life and in your community who disagree with you. Have honest conversations. Listen. You may be surprised by what you find. And you may even end up working together to make a big difference in our world.
Elevate,
Wes

| | Dear Friend,

How much do you know about the Electoral College?

It's an important topic, and one vital to our nation's future.

You see, a movement is growing, led by progressives but supported by many well-meaning Americans, to change the way we elect our president.

**Their goal: to get rid of the Electoral College altogether, and "move beyond" the Constitution and Declaration. **

**That 's why I hope you'll take our National Quiz on Presidential Selection today.** It's a quick and engaging way to test your own understanding of how our presidents are elected.

**You can take your quiz by using the secure link below:**

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale-college-national-quiz-on-presidential-selection](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/Il-sq_Wh6d11VZNdX9vN3TTPRCfgTGUvukI_Ls85kKNAvOLz3PQPCGDYz_FTs_1SlqMNVNEc6oJmZdppVJ1imNo3qQj9W3alSjUQd7ogsBkM6K4Gis1dQvhKoGRkfOR50Wjpn2On27am4EJasW3IWsAGkwiARphofTEQBoCdl6APqzbA1j5ayTZNNR2EVppEHme-NuEHqb-mFv3A7TNzgCd15gSgmTRo1OVt63qnBUfp7eDda6TsT2d6pARkynlx2IDLbTNoZrnvp81Ui_fOZtkyHVmLXc9gUOWq2_V4Eq5p0Izm97hk8XCGM_mVOkv2f28ld4EvousVTesV8gm8sS4Rx9HRdodkaRjtPb46sE9cV5Jn1iMZU_piu8b-njgBy-goxNF7SYv5A6hBE-kIjgMxTcN_vLlsv7ojT_Rw9-7f7saVwfAz6Zc1Q1owFBLLUErWLidEFjdtvjUnVRv-Ep5aGbNCiSmzkBfbvR2i-Lat4L5UX1QhIdhSjCS3EE5nXkYLdMKXVLs053z_lAj6wt1_TJvhuI-tzZmQvtfGqLnpTnNPCYajERvzvrjcjGM7hZhGO4LkOol-MNEv6cPLba3urKd4nOftNPOkBl78CJUqZbrbTra6GTOT0gQwr_Jn7PoHoLcvz23iD-TxE6DE-TjAIhmrJ_Ez12Z2EfChDazkr2etMfKC6uh7js8qvAi1N1b7bgA9k6Z5WTwOsElnRYn4DdS-eCvrZAe0_G55UZiPqAdGtG-7wJDp_kznhRWYT1Y4mrIhgEUfexYZtbbIdU4C6wK6Q4TEhx4O3S-ViEdZ3eZpYfJVcNHbr2L-7eCr0Q/MSeQrzYPq6bMBaM35Of75tI9KMH03fnB/24)

For most of our history, the Electoral College was uncontroversial. It was understood to be a safeguard for free and representative government.

**But today, dozens of states have joined together to undermine this key constitutional protection.**

The push to "move beyond" the Constitution stems from the failure of too many schools to teach American civics properly. Many citizens today don't fully understand the importance of the Constitution and the Electoral College in preserving liberty.

To counter this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, **reaching and teaching millions** of Americans in all 50 states.

When you take the **National Quiz on Presidential Selection** , you'll gain a clearer understanding of how the Electoral College upholds liberty--and you'll have the opportunity to **share this** information with your fellow Americans.

So please take your **National Quiz on Presidential Selection**. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

**You can take the quiz using the secure link I 've provided below: **

[https://info.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale-college-national-quiz-on-presidential-selection](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/Oa6XdZBZOpEaNcv9N6MsEoQOYIwRpK3uo19cfMeVLJUPMo-khusE6AB-rS8Ne3MRccEpWaNtsvmwMjP7N-_vfWnKaAWHlSAicDmeNfqj_8n4D6KmAUAGaGCt3PDIJjGWL4JIB-vqte4jhR_pM2V0XMWOuIDNsI7nwzy92EY3XFs71Ocz9q0JJNytQKAZHexLTmhVAVig0ojtyqDyllYTyGjgKxl5cCpxKLStWEHRz0pBfQVHtR7YDR8kH21Nj-IiH4qVX9Gb1Nr2ekrmwwQ8Cs8KOefN22tz8GUI43T1xLoVxkY08urC74xCYUwaB84FjSm8c78F9Gul2ISV4a66E_4DmOxJc-niZ76a-mXsKmiHe_GPN328A9kuuA0-wFskJHlQ5-VsMK8b9_hby1Eys0_dnpHoMxGubezybXXhhvwHP3MPZnp-AtvPlKXEYxcGcj77WELSMXTkL6hbOASiu6r09KOSvGYqf7xvrMnJpwDbjTZJ2F_V6qyAy874yPan6UEKvHUCpANIT4MlBS1lN_Y-KgA-iBU21GRACmcxip2X89Vs-NCIw7g9-f0ekpsd5GhlBda8SS9YWV5AyMd3JrSgFN5IvsJWO5jbkGBORgsp0eCXPgV8PJBSJSbMGWt6hkz2HG7V32BK7wN6s-yIzCjXVVPQguJLndRIwMBwsrMyCyQIPmphTCs2m0UdzVUFhOvAbkDkpDESODhcc4WQoBX5UDFRPLloJsk3PM04Jl5X0rDmSGGuaQQeTLwfh7Ch4DrqJVqNyYVDNTiMNj7XaJVWNNynC2SWzBRjZy2F3AuNv8lBxhKJi25HJ-vmXMVQLw/nPcDP9kvnHFZvvFBH23s4rxjScu3LXbk/24)

**As a thank-you for taking the quiz, I 'll send you a free 12-minute video with a Hillsdale College professor that explains the history and purpose of the Electoral College. **

The video provides a concise, engaging, and insightful overview of the Electoral College and its significance. It would be a great resource to send to a friend or a family member!

One other thing.

Hillsdale refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding--even indirectly through student loans or grants--so that we can pursue truth and defend liberty independent of meddling bureaucrats in Washington, D.C. That's why your support matters so much.

So, after you take your quiz, please also consider giving a **tax-deductible gift of $35, $50, or even $100** to help us share this video with millions of Americans--especially young people who don't understand how the Constitution preserves liberty through the Electoral College. Your gift also funds our other nationwide educational outreach.

Thank you for standing with Hillsdale College in the effort to educate Americans about the Constitution and safeguard the principles of liberty. Good luck on the quiz and enjoy your video!

Warm regards,

Bill Gray '01
Vice President
Institutional Advancement

If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this | | | | Dear Friend, How much do you know about the Electoral College? It's an important topic, and one vital to our nation's future. You see, a movement is growing, led by progressives but supported by many well-meaning Americans, to change the way we elect our president. Their goal: to get rid of the Electoral College altogether, and "move beyond" the Constitution and Declaration. That 's why I hope you'll take our National Quiz on Presidential Selection today. It's a quick and engaging way to test your own understanding of how our presidents are elected. You can take your quiz by using the secure link below: For most of our history, the Electoral College was uncontroversial. It was understood to be a safeguard for free and representative government. But today, dozens of states have joined together to undermine this key constitutional protection. The push to "move beyond" the Constitution stems from the failure of too many schools to teach American civics properly. Many citizens today don't fully understand the importance of the Constitution and the Electoral College in preserving liberty. To counter this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, reaching and teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states. When you take the National Quiz on Presidential Selection , you'll gain a clearer understanding of how the Electoral College upholds liberty--and you'll have the opportunity to share this information with your fellow Americans. So please take your National Quiz on Presidential Selection. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the quiz using the secure link I 've provided below: As a thank-you for taking the quiz, I 'll send you a free 12-minute video with a Hillsdale College professor that explains the history and purpose of the Electoral College. The video provides a concise, engaging, and insightful overview of the Electoral College and its significance. It would be a great resource to send to a friend or a family member! One other thing. Hillsdale refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding--even indirectly through student loans or grants--so that we can pursue truth and defend liberty independent of meddling bureaucrats in Washington, D.C. That's why your support matters so much. So, after you take your quiz, please also consider giving a tax-deductible gift of $35, $50, or even $100 to help us share this video with millions of Americans--especially young people who don't understand how the Constitution preserves liberty through the Electoral College. Your gift also funds our other nationwide educational outreach. Thank you for standing with Hillsdale College in the effort to educate Americans about the Constitution and safeguard the principles of liberty. Good luck on the quiz and enjoy your video! Warm regards, Bill Gray '01 Vice President Institutional Advancement Hillsdale College P.S. If you know a young person who cares about civics and the Constitution, please share this email and the quiz with them! This is a new one: Donald Trump promised on live TV that if Republicans keep control of Congress in November, he'll give every American adult $5,000. _**I call bull$h!t.**_ Donald Trump has played this game with the American people before. He promised that American consumers wouldn’t bear the cost of his tariffs, but we all know that we have. Then he promised $2,000 rebate checks from tariff revenue for every American (maybe mine got lost in the mail?). He promised that DOGE cuts would mean a $5k check for every American — still waiting on that too. He promised that he would end forever wars, but really, he started another one. I could go on and on about the broken promises, but there’s a bigger problem here. _And look: I don’t blame any American for wanting $5,000. Donald Trump and his policy choices have made everything more expensive, so people *need* more help paying their bills._ _But no one is ever going to see this money. It’s just the latest in a long series of Donald Trump cons._ **And all of this contributes to the American people losing faith in the government. ** We’re all watching a president abuse the highest office in the land to rake in huge profits (the extent of which are apparently without global precedent), while making light of Americans’ actual struggles to make ends meet. And we’re also all watching a Congress that has the power to stop him, but fails to act because Republicans refuse to join Democrats to do anything about it. It’s clear that as long as Republicans control Congress, Trump will keep making and breaking promises, and keep abusing the power of the presidency to enrich himself and his family — all while doing nothing to actually lower costs. **That’s why it’s SO important for us to flip the House in November and kick the GOP out of power. ** _**[If you’re with me on this, will you contribute today? Young families are wondering whether they'll ever be able to buy their first home. Renters are watching more of each paycheck go toward keeping a roof over their heads. Seniors on fixed incomes are stretching already-tight budgets. And too many people are being forced to consider leaving the communities they know and love because they can no longer afford to stay. The Regime Open — Weekend Briefing, September 19, 2026
The Pipeline Workaround Just Failed Its First Real Customer
Aramco cut October crude entirely to at least two European refiners, oil fell anyway, and short-term yields hit 52-week highs — while Washington approved $24.3 billion in F-35s for Saudi Arabia instead of troops.
|
---
Markets are closed today, so this edition reviews Friday’s close and the developments that complicate Thursday’s relief rally. **Verified fact:** Friday's session was mixed — the Dow slipped 0.18% to 51,682.64, the S&P; 500 edged up 0.17% to 7,650.50, and the Nasdaq rose 0.39% to 26,522.55. Oil fell for a third straight session, with WTI and Brent both settling near $100.70, but the 10-year Treasury yield climbed back to 5.00%, and 2-year and 3-year yields hit 52-week highs even as oil eased — a divergence worth sitting with. Separately, Saudi Aramco told at least two European refining customers they will receive no crude oil in October, and the State Department approved a $24.3 billion sale of 48 F-35 stealth jets to Saudi Arabia.
| | Regime Signal 01 — The Oman Workaround Is Cracking Exactly Where This Newsletter Flagged It Would
---|---
**Verified fact:** the East-West Pipeline, damaged by drone strikes on September 11, normally carries 4–5 million barrels a day — roughly 4–5% of global supply — to the Red Sea port of Yanbu. Three pumping stations sustained damage, with repair estimates ranging from partial resumption within days to full recovery in five to six weeks. Aramco has now cut October deliveries entirely to at least two European refiners, affecting roughly 577,000 barrels a day of typical OECD European volume. **Our interpretation:** Thursday's rally treated the Oman ship-to-ship workaround as a sufficient substitute; Friday's cancellation notices show it isn't, at least not for every customer — exactly the strain this newsletter flagged as the fix's limiting factor two days ago.
| | Regime Signal 02 — Washington's Support for Saudi Arabia Just Became Concrete, and Different in Kind
---|---
**Verified fact:** the State Department approved a $24.3 billion sale of 48 F-35 stealth fighters to Saudi Arabia, advancing as Houthi attacks escalate. **Our interpretation:** this is a different form of support than the direct military intervention Trump reportedly declined to provide MBS earlier this week. Arming an ally at scale while declining to fight alongside it directly is a coherent, if risk-shifting, policy — it deepens U.S. commitment to Saudi Arabia's defense without adding U.S. forces to an active war.
| | Regime Signal 03 — Short-End Yields Moved Opposite to Oil, and That's the Signal to Watch
---|---
**What remains unknown** is why 2- and 3-year yields hit 52-week highs on the same day oil fell for a third consecutive session — normally a disinflationary signal that would ease near-term rate expectations, not raise them. **Our interpretation:** this could reflect markets pricing the Fed's dot-plot signal of a further 2026 hike more than any single day's energy move, consistent with this week's broader finding that markets are now trading the rate path, not the headline decision.
| | What to Watch Monday
---|---
Whether Aramco's European supply cuts spread beyond the two named refiners, and whether oil resumes climbing once markets reopen and digest both the pipeline reality check and the F-35 sale's signal about the durability of U.S.-Saudi commitment.
| | |
---

* * *
Donald Trump banned MS Now, CNN, and Politico from the White House this weekend, and the media is in an uproar. They have every right to be. It is an unprecedented attack on the First Amendment from a president who has never once demonstrated respect for the Constitution he swore an oath to. The courts will likely undo it. I hope they do, quickly. I feel for the reporters who showed up to work yesterday and found out they'd been locked out for the crime of doing their jobs.
And I want you to notice what else happened at almost exactly the same moment.
The Washington Post published a report that Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth have been lying about the number of American service members killed in this illegal war in Iran. They're lying about the dead. They're lying about the wounded. They're lying about the condition of our bases in the Middle East. They're lying about our missile capabilities and they're lying about Iran's. And they are refusing to give the families of the dead the benefits those families are owed -- because the president won't categorize this as a war, because categorizing it as a war would force Congress to do its constitutional job and actually vote on it.
Read the article when you have a minute. It is one of the most sickening things I have seen from this administration, and I have seen a lot.
It is also, for the most part, not what the media is talking about today.
I'm not going to sit here and tell you Donald Trump is some Machiavellian genius. He obviously isn't. He's a rabidly stupid moron who is crashing our economy, getting people killed, and careening his own party off a cliff six weeks before the midterms. But he does understand one thing at a bone-deep level, and it's the only thing he's ever been good at: the press loves nothing more than covering the press. Kick the press corps and they will spend three days talking about the press corps. He's not a chess player. He's a guy who has figured out which button makes the noise.
And we bit. Again.
* * *

* * *
My entire X feed today is the media ban. Every cable hit I've seen today is the media ban. It is not the economy. It is not the corruption. It is not the fact that our own government has been lying to us about how many Americans it has gotten killed in a war it started without authorization. That's the trade we just made, and we made it in about ninety minutes.
I am not telling you the press ban doesn't matter. It matters. Freedom of the press is not a side issue, and I'll be right there in that fight. What I'm telling you is that there are families in this country right now grieving a child, a husband, a wife, a parent who served -- people who did something braver than anything I have ever done in my life, who put their bodies between the rest of us and the worst things in the world -- and those families cannot get acknowledgment from their government. They cannot get the benefits they are owed. They cannot even get the country to say out loud what happened to the person they loved. And the reason is paperwork. The reason is a political calculation about a congressional vote.
I keep thinking about the day Donald Trump used a dead soldier's casket in a fundraising email. Do you remember that? It was a blip. Two days of coverage and then it was gone, buried under the next thing, which was buried under the next thing.
That's the part that has really gotten to me this afternoon. The sheer volume of it. I know I'm not the first person to say this, but if you gathered every person on this planet and ranked them by how much they remember about this administration, I have to be somewhere near the top of that list. It's my job. It's been my life for a decade. And even I have forgotten dozens of genuinely horrific things these people have done. That's not an accident. That's the strategy. Flood the zone until nothing sticks, until outrage becomes weather, until even the people whose entire profession is paying attention can't hold it all in their heads at once.
So here's where I land, on a Saturday, in my office, writing a newsletter I had no plans to write on a day I meant to spend with my family.
The corruption, the attacks on our democracy, the destruction of our economy, the grotesqueness of this administration -- it is unprecedented in American history. Which means the accountability has to be unprecedented too. And the reforms that make sure this can never happen again have to be unprecedented as well.
I don't care what wing of the Democratic Party you come from. I don't care about your lane, your donors, or your careful positioning. If you are not prepared to use power -- to hold these people accountable to the fullest extent of the law, to claw back the money Trump and Jared Kushner and the rest of them have stolen from the American people, to transform this system of government so it serves the public instead of a handful of corrupt tech billionaires, to put power back in the hands of working people who are outworking every politician and every bureaucrat in that White House -- then you are not getting my vote. You're just not.
It is time to elevate a different kind of politician.
Because understand what we have learned this week. If you will lie about how many Americans died in an illegal war you started, six weeks before an election, you will lie about anything. You will hurt anyone. And you are never, ever going to produce a single idea that makes one person's life better. These are the worst among us, and a country cannot survive if people like that are not exposed daily, shamed daily, and held accountable for their crimes.
So no, I'm not going to spend today on the press room. I'm holding those military families closest to my heart. They deserve better than a government that won't even say their names, and they deserve better than a country that's looking the other way because the president threw a shinier object into the room.
That's where I'm at today. That's me laying my heart on the line, on a weekend, when I'd rather be with my kid.
I love you guys. Enjoy your weekend. And take whatever you're feeling right now and turn it into some kind of action -- that's worth infinitely more than the feeling.

So here's where I land, on a Saturday, in my office, writing a newsletter I had no plans to write on a day I meant to spend with my family. The corruption, the attacks on our democracy, the destruction of our economy, the grotesqueness of this administration -- it is unprecedented in American history. Which means the accountability has to be unprecedented too. And the reforms that make sure this can never happen again have to be unprecedented as well. I don't care what wing of the Democratic Party you come from. I don't care about your lane, your donors, or your careful positioning. If you are not prepared to use power -- to hold these people accountable to the fullest extent of the law, to claw back the money Trump and Jared Kushner and the rest of them have stolen from the American people, to transform this system of government so it serves the public instead of a handful of corrupt tech billionaires, to put power back in the hands of working people who are outworking every politician and every bureaucrat in that White House -- then you are not getting my vote. You're just not. It is time to elevate a different kind of politician. Because understand what we have learned this week. If you will lie about how many Americans died in an illegal war you started, six weeks before an election, you will lie about anything. You will hurt anyone. And you are never, ever going to produce a single idea that makes one person's life better. These are the worst among us, and a country cannot survive if people like that are not exposed daily, shamed daily, and held accountable for their crimes. So no, I'm not going to spend today on the press room. I'm holding those military families closest to my heart. They deserve better than a government that won't even say their names, and they deserve better than a country that's looking the other way because the president threw a shinier object into the room. That's where I'm at today. That's me laying my heart on the line, on a weekend, when I'd rather be with my kid. I love you guys. Enjoy your weekend. And take whatever you're feeling right now and turn it into some kind of action -- that's worth infinitely more than the feeling. Peter,
Earlier this month marked one year since we launched this campaign. I want to take a moment to recognize that.
[****](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/aYcihqaFwllIDyK38Fc6AA~~/AAUS1hA~/pxFQ9wxMNBRDtDWXID-maWuAD1a0E9HnmRwrITwaaNixMyErlVlIOdP56_Ge0wCbT0FQQwvb2foDtzgXWp5wBH1ukCx1TQ3tJNVOwYFlDJ6kTfAIPqhYyuZ9JAOQikM-O3Iv9PyFMzI1SIHd4M_9P2NjxooB2fhGaJE4SXcaq3PG8Qj2GCkhGA86P0J4caDTgIx0WZmx_vC_F15wvopOJkTuvzo9ynxwMOmHT1w2Vl2jC2d_ZMlyFds9mSaXP9cjUbAamUjFjyMZyWuEpSszuA~~)
A lot has happened in twelve months. The maps were redrawn. We relaunched. We went from 6 counties to 17. We traveled every corner of this district, sat in more living rooms than I can count, and met people who reminded me every single day why this is worth fighting for.
The lines may have changed. The mission never did.
TN-05 deserves a congressman who shows up, fights for the people who sent him there, and makes them proud. That's what I set out to do a year ago, and it's what I'm going to keep doing all the way to November 3rd.

body:
Florida deserves better than this.
---
Derek, Angie Nixon here. Republicans have controlled Florida for years, and they cannot hold that much power while pretending they bear no responsibility for what working families are experiencing: grocery bills that keep climbing, rent and insurance eating up paychecks, childcare families can't afford, and healthcare that costs too much. [**Can you split a $20 donation between the DNC and me right now to help change that in November?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-nixon-split?refcode=em_20260919_9242_fr&amount=20&refcode2=9242_22930333_Jacyn9&akid=9242%2E22930333%2EJacyn9) **[CHIP IN $20](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-nixon-split?refcode=em_20260919_9242_fr&amount=20&refcode2=9242_22930333_Jacyn9&akid=9242%2E22930333%2EJacyn9)** Here's what Republicans understand about me, and why it scares them. I just shocked the political establishment by winning the Democratic nomination despite being dramatically outspent, proving that people-powered organizing can beat big money. I'm a working-class Black woman who isn't going to Washington to protect wealthy donors or preserve the status quo. I've been clear about why I'm running: I want government to work for working people instead of the wealthy and powerful interests that have dominated Washington and Tallahassee. clean_body: | | | | | Patriot , I flew above battlefields, passing burning husks of armored vehicles, and in Iraq I poured enough sand out of my boots to fill a desert. You would think that after flying an Apache helicopter through an active war zone, and having God knows how many stray bullets shot my direction, there’s not a thing on this planet that could scare me. I thought so too, until my team reminded me about what’s coming in the next few days. Let me explain. This campaign’s bigger than anything I’ve done in Iraq. Rather than covering for a team on the ground, the fate of more than 10 million people will be decided in November. Campaigning isn’t easy, and sometimes it feels like the weight of the world is on my shoulders. Just before I typed this email, my team reminded me about our upcoming End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline. This isn’t just an arbitrary deadline; this is one of our last BIG goals before the November election. I’m not going to ask you to dig deep into your pockets. All I’m asking is a $1 or more donation, which will go right into my campaign's war chest and help me and President Trump take down the Democrat machine come November. As a combat veteran and a patriot - I give you my word that every dollar matters, and I’m eternally thankful for ANY gift you can make. Time is running out. Thank you for listening, and I hope I can count on your help. | | — John James Republican Nominee for Governor | | Paid for by John James for MI | | 35744 Van Dyke Avenue, Sterling Heights, MI 48312 The use of John James' military images, uniforms, or personnel does not imply endorsement by the Department of War or any branch of the U.S. military. |

_I debated Sen. Marshall at the Kansas State Fair last week -- and the crowd made it clear they're ready for change._
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/cd5e7d38-47e2-4fce-b68f-27b0c2c4fca9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
One week ago, I took to the stage at the Kansas State Fair to debate Sen. Roger Marshall. We got into tariffs, the war in Iran and other corrupt and chaotic politics that are hurting people in Kansas and across the nation.
**The crowd was fired up, and so was I.**
I've listened to hundreds of Kansans talk about the problems they're facing. The struggle to afford groceries. The challenge of getting quality healthcare close to home. The fear of losing their businesses, their Social Security, their homes.
That's why I was so eager for this debate. After _listening_ to so many people, I have a plan to tackle the problems that corrupt politicians have created. Like I told the crowd, I'm ready to protect Kansas families from rising costs; end these disastrous tariffs; help end the war with Iran; defend Social Security; support Kansas farmers, ranchers and small-business owners; and fight against the chaos and corruption in Washington.
Sen. Marshall, on the other hand? He's not ready to do any of that. How could he be? He's out of touch with what Kansans are struggling with because _he doesn 't listen._ More than 550 days ago, he got upset at a public town hall he held and walked out. After that, he refused to talk to Kansans because according to him, it's "dangerous" and "non-productive."
But the crowd at our debate made sure he heard them anyway. And when the senator tried to defend **suing more than 700 Kansans** as "common business practices," the crowd chanted, "Shame on you."
CNN called it "not a good moment for Roger Marshall."
I would agree. In fact, "not good" might be an understatement.
**Folks, Kansas deserves a leader who will fight for** _**Kansans**_** -- not fight to make **_**their own**_**life better at Kansans ' expense.**
But maybe Sen. Marshall doesn't think he owes Kansans anything. After all, he spends a lot of his time in Florida, nearly 1,500 miles away from the people he represents!
Folks, we Kansans are smart. We're tough. We believe in decency, respect and truth. When someone isn't being straight with us, we can tell. I think that's why, when Roger Marshall asked the crowd, "Who do you want solving this problem?" they immediately started chanting: "Not you!"
The people who watched the debate can tell he's not interested in solving their problems. Under his watch, they've seen gasoline rise to $4.00/gallon and diesel hit a record-breaking $6.00+/gallon. They've witnessed tariffs drive up their cost of living and hurt their fellow farmers and manufacturers. They've watched while 51,000 people lost their Medicaid and 18,000 kids lost their SNAP benefits.
**Everywhere they turn, they 've seen Sen. Marshall fail them. And on Saturday, they called him to task for it.**
I know we can do better than Roger Marshall. It's time to retire him to Florida so we can start tackling the issues he's helped create.
**I can 't do it without your help, though. Unlike Sen. Marshall, I won't take a dime of corporate PAC money. That's why I depend on grassroots support from people like you. [Please, will you make a donation today and help me defeat Roger Marshall in November?](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/cd5e7d38-47e2-4fce-b68f-27b0c2c4fca9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
**The debate showed Kansas and the country that the people of this great state are ready for a champion. Let 's keep the momentum going.**
[Donate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/cd5e7d38-47e2-4fce-b68f-27b0c2c4fca9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Thank you,
